title: Senior Customer Engineer, Named - Seattle
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Seattle, WA<br></strong></h3> <hr> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong><br></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.<br></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong><br>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong><br>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p> <p>For Washington based hires: Estimated annual salary of $202,000 - title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years. What you'll be doing You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost. Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs. Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads. Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently. Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery. Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help. Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general. Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil. Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams. Our humble expectations Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus. Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation. Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on. A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact. Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost. Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction. What we offer Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence. Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company. Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US. Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence. Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. title: Customer Success Associate
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. What you will do: As a Customer Success Associate in EMEA, you will play a key role in scaling and strengthening our international post-sales experience as part of a growing global Customer Success organization. You will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of mid-market customers, partnering directly with technical and business stakeholders to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region. We are open to candidates based in the Netherlands who are willing to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office. Responsibilities Manage a portfolio of EMEA mid-market customers as their primary post-sales technical advisor, developing a deep understanding of the NodeZero platform to guide successful adoption Cultivate champions with security leaders—from analysts to CISOs—and guide them through the lifecycle of adoption, expansion, and advocacy Deliver technical onboarding and enablement to drive adoption of NodeZero, including advanced features like Tripwires, Insights, and Rapid Response, ensuring customers realize maximum value Proactively identify customer needs and potential challenges, suggesting solutions that improve their experience and enhance their cybersecurity posture Partner closely with IT and Security teams (SOC, red/blue teams, AppSec, etc.) to help interpret pentest results, prioritize remediation, and guide long-term offensive security strategy Collaborate closely with Sales and Renewals teams to drive retention and growth by identifying expansion opportunities, aligning on account strategy, and ensuring a seamless renewal process Act as a customer advocate, relaying customer feedback and technical issues to our internal teams to help drive the evolution of our product and services Conduct regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to align on strategy, secure executive buy-in, and showcase business outcomes. Contribute to documentation, training materials, and repeatable playbooks to scale technical success across the region Maintain detailed records of customer health and touchpoints using internal CS platforms What We’re Looking For 3+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Client Services, within a SaaS cybersecurity environment In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity practices and principles Deep understanding of enterprise security, information technology, cloud, or offensive security is highly preferred Strong customer acumen—able to align solutions to business priorities and present clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders Experience managing a book of business with revenue targets (ARR, NRR, GRR) Startup or high-growth company experience is preferred; you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments Location: based in the Netherlands and able to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office Comfortable with tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, and JIRA; detail-oriented and organized English fluency required; fluency in French, Spanish, or German preferred Perks of Horizon3.ai Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. Compensation and Values At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations. Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €70,000 - €85,000 OTE 80/20 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills. Deine Aufgaben Prospecting: Identifiziere und recherchiere potenzielle Kunden, Zielunternehmen und relevante Entscheidungsträger. Outbound Sales: Übernimm die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kunden durch Cold Calling, E-Mail und LinkedIn, um qualifizierte Verkaufschancen zu generieren. Kundengespräche: Verstehe die Herausforderungen potenzieller Kunden, vermittle den Mehrwert unserer Lösung, behandle Einwände und vereinbare Termine. Sales Strategy: Teste unterschiedliche Ansprachemethoden, Botschaften und Vertriebstechniken, um unsere Conversion Rates kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Pipeline Development: Hilf dabei, unsere Sales-Pipeline aufzubauen und zu verwalten und erste Gespräche in konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu verwandeln. Deal Ownership: Übernimm mit wachsender Erfahrung mehr Verantwortung im gesamten Sales-Prozess – von Discovery Calls bis hin zum eigenständigen Abschluss von Deals. Was wir dir bieten Schnelle Karriereentwicklung: Die Möglichkeit, dich vom BDR zum Account Executive weiterzuentwickeln, eigene Deals zu übernehmen und deine Karriere im B2B-Vertrieb aufzubauen. Ungedeckelte Provision: Leistung zählt. Je erfolgreicher du bist, desto mehr kannst du verdienen – ohne Obergrenze bei der Provision. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern: Arbeite eng mit dem Gründerteam zusammen, erhalte persönliches Coaching und lerne, wie man ein Unternehmen von Grund auf aufbaut. Echte Verantwortung: Du bist nicht hier, um nur zuzuschauen. Du übernimmst eigenständig die Kundenansprache, sprichst mit echten Entscheidern und trägst direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei. Flexible Teilzeit: Verbinde dein Studium mit einer verantwortungsvollen Tätigkeit in einem schnell wachsenden Startup. KI- und Startup-Erfahrung: Arbeite an der Schnittstelle von künstlicher Intelligenz, Technologie und Business Development. Was wir von dir erwarten Du bist aktuell an einer Universität oder Hochschule eingeschrieben und möchtest neben deinem Studium praktische Business-Erfahrung sammeln. Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse und hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu kommunizieren. Du bist ehrgeizig, proaktiv und motiviert, messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Du hast kein Problem damit, auf fremde Menschen zuzugehen, Fragen zu stellen und mit Ablehnung umzugehen. Du interessierst dich für KI, Startups und die Frage, wie Unternehmen wachsen. Du arbeitest zuverlässig, eigenständig und möchtest dich kontinuierlich verbessern. Erste Erfahrungen in Sales, Business Development, Recruiting, Consulting oder anderen kundenorientierten Tätigkeiten sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Dein Ehrgeiz, deine Einstellung und deine Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als deine bisherige Erfahrung oder deine Noten. Warum Helix? Lerne einen der wertvollsten Skills im Geschäftsleben. Egal, ob du später selbst gründen, ins Consulting gehen oder eine Karriere im Vertrieb aufbauen möchtest: Die Fähigkeit, überzeugend zu kommunizieren, zu verhandeln und zu verkaufen, wird dir immer einen entscheidenden Vorteil verschaffen. Bei Helix lernst du durch praktische Erfahrung. Du sprichst mit echten Entscheidern, verstehst, wie Unternehmen Kaufentscheidungen treffen, und erlebst aus erster Hand, wie aus einem ersten Gespräch ein zahlender Kunde wird. Wachse mit dem Unternehmen. Wir bauen unseren Vertrieb von Grund auf auf. Das bedeutet, dass du die Möglichkeit hast, Prozesse mitzugestalten, neue Strategien zu testen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, für die du in einem größeren Unternehmen normalerweise deutlich länger brauchen würdest. Deine Leistung bestimmt deine Möglichkeiten. Wir suchen Menschen, die lernen und Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Wenn du konstant gute Ergebnisse lieferst, bekommst du die Möglichkeit, über die reine Kundenakquise hinauszuwachsen, eigene Verkaufsgespräche zu führen und Deals abzuschließen. Wisse, worauf du dich einlässt. Vertrieb ist nicht immer einfach. Du wirst viele Anrufe tätigen, häufig ein Nein hören und Gespräche führen, die zu nichts führen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du dadurch Durchhaltevermögen, Selbstbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, andere Menschen zu überzeugen – Fähigkeiten, die dich dein gesamtes Berufsleben begleiten werden. Stell dich noch in einem video kurz vor, erzähle uns, was du studierst und warum du Lust auf Vertrieb hast. Wir möchten vor allem einen ersten Eindruck von dir als Person bekommen. Ein professionell produziertes Video ist nicht notwendig. title: Control & Flight Test Engineer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands? title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
description: <p>The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.</p> <p> </p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.</p> <p> </p> <p>The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model's outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. custom mid-size models for high-throughput stream processing, and train them at scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Optimize these models from start to finish, working across both the mathematics and the systems, often by finding mathematical reformulations that fit the hardware and software constraints better.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Build the training data pipelines the work depends on when matters most to users.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Build an agentic layer on top of the models to analyze, validate, and act on their outputs.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Build lightweight into production systems with real throughput and cost constraints.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>You have a working knowledge of how GPUs work, and a track record of making models run efficiently title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
description: <p>AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.</p> <p>Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.</p> <p>The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.</li> <li>Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.</li> <li>Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.</li> <li>Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.</li> <li>Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and experimentation pillar — so that what you learn moves freely in both directions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a PhD, MS or equivalent research experience in a scientific field, with strong applied mathematics grounding.</li> <li>6+ years of relevant applied science or ML engineering experience, including setting technical direction for others.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent post-training data: how it is created, managed, and how training-data quality is controlled. This is the requirement that matters most.</li> <li>You have real domain expertise in LLMs and agentic applications — not classical ML fine-tuning. Fine-tuning classifiers or traditional models is a different problem from the one this team is solving.</li> <li>You have evaluated agents or LLM applications, and can define what 'good' means before you measure it.</li> <li>You are a strong programmer and production software engineer. Python at minimum, plus the ability to ship scalable production systems and work with distributed systems.</li> <li>You collaborate well across engineering and science teams, and you're comfortable being the domain expert who decides what comes next.</li> <li>You thrive in ambiguity and can make sound technical calls when the path isn't yet defined.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on LLM fine-tuning, post-training or model training experience.</li> <li>Background in statistics, experiment design and data analysis.</li> <li>Experience deploying production-level ML infrastructure.</li> <li>Observability or monitoring systems background.</li> <li>Architecture-level understanding of LLMs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Benefits & Growth:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture and the ability to join our Community Guilds</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog: </strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. description: <p>Datadog's Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) group is one of the company's fastest-growing product areas, spanning Real User Monitoring (RUM), Product Analytics, Synthetic Monitoring, Feature Flags, and Datadog Studio, our newest AI-native observability surface. title: AI Research Scientist - Datadog AI Research (DAIR)
description: <p>As a Research Scientist on our team, you will partner with Research Engineers, working on fundamental research problems and collaborating with Datadog's product and engineering teams to translate research advances into products.</p> <p> </p> <p>Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/bits-ai-sre/">Bits AI</a>, <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/engineering/self-optimizing-system/">Bits Evolve</a>, and our <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/ai/toto-boom-unleashed/">time series foundation model</a>), Datadog AI Research tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.</p> <p> </p> <p>We are focused on two research areas:</p> <p> </p> <ol> <li><strong>World Models for Observability</strong> -- Training multimodal foundation models that learn the joint dynamics of distributed systems across metrics, traces, logs, topology, and events. These models power advanced forecasting, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, counterfactual simulation ("what if?"), and provide a learned planning backbone for our autonomous agents.</li> <li><strong>Trained Agents for Observability </strong>-- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.</li> </ol> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Conduct research in generative AI and machine learning, building specialized foundation models and trained agents for observability</li> <li>Train multimodal models on large-scale, diverse telemetry data (metrics, logs, traces, topology, events) using distributed training infrastructure</li> <li>Design and build simulated environments and RL training loops for on-policy agent training and evaluation</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering) to integrate capabilities like multimodal world modeling and autonomous agents into Datadog's products</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of foundation models, world models, and RL-based agent research</li> <li>Contribute to research publications, present at top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML), and help open-source key model artifacts and benchmarks</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>You hold a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, with deep expertise in areas like generative modeling, world models, AI agents, reinforcement learning, or multimodal learning (or have training, post-training, and inference techniques for large foundation models</li> <li>You can explain complex models and research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> </ul> applications</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GPU programming and optimization, including CUDA</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. description: Head of Product - Cards - Amsterdam Build with us Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind. We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver. If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you. Your impact Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants. As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market. The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it. What you'll ship End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement. Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with. Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth. Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio. Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team. What You’ll Bring Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share. Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications. Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape. Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes. Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them. Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. title: Model Operations Lead, AI Gateway
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA</strong></h3> <h3 data-path-to-node="2">About AI Gateway</h3> <p data-path-to-node="3">AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6">Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.</p> <p data-path-to-node="7">This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. Expect to manage people, projects, model stock, and operations all at once.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="9">About the Role</h3> <ul> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build and lead the models team:</strong> Hire, coach, and grow the people who run the catalog today and build its intelligence over time. Give people real ownership, give direct feedback, and grow leads who can run their own areas.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run model launches end-to-end:</strong> Scope integrations, coordinate testing and evals, confirm pricing, metering, capacity, and security, and get docs and announcements ready. Prepare day-zero launches in advance so they can ship in minutes.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Keep the catalog true:</strong> Make sure what we publish (capabilities, limits, versions, prices) matches what developers actually get. Catch silent regressions, such as broken tool calling, truncated streams, quantization changes, or usage and pricing mismatches, before customers do.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build model intelligence:</strong> As it comes online, own the evals, capability maps, and per-task rankings behind our auto-routing profiles and model recommendations. Make sure they measure what they claim to, and connect regressions to routing decisions so customers who chose "auto" aren't the ones who discover a problem.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Treat the catalog and intelligence as products:</strong> Have a point of view on which models belong in the catalog, which routing profiles to ship, and what market intelligence to publish. Base it on usage, quality, reliability, and cost data. Turn what you learn into roadmap input.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run a lightweight operating cadence:</strong> Keep one source of truth for what's in flight, who owns it, what's blocked, and what ships next. Keep Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned and informed without status meetings.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,6,0" data-index-in-node="0">Automate relentlessly:</strong> Turn repeatable steps into scripts, tools, and agent workflows: endpoint validation, eval runs, catalog and pricing reconciliation, regression detection, and provider follow-ups. Manual effort per launch should fall as the catalog grows.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="12">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="13,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Day-Zero & Quality Launches:</strong> Ensure new models launch on day zero with tested capabilities, accurate pricing, docs, and a clear call on routing eligibility.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Catalog Reliability & Health:</strong> Ensure the catalog reflects reality, and proactively identify when a model or provider is underperforming before customers notice.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Auto-Routing & Optimization:</strong> Deliver auto-routing that measurably beats a fixed model choice on cost or quality for users.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Developer Trust & Methodology:</strong> Build and maintain trusted rankings and recommendations grounded in solid methodology.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Partner & Stakeholder Management:</strong> Set clear expectations for providers, while keeping Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,5,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Team Leadership & Growth:</strong> Provide clear ownership and direction so the team knows what's next, who owns it, and how to grow into bigger roles.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,6,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,6,0" data-index-in-node="0">Operational Scalability:</strong> Continually drive down the human effort required for each launch, eval, and routing update through tools and automation.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="15">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="16,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">People Leadership:</strong> Experience hiring, managing, and growing engineers or operators, giving direct feedback, delegating real ownership, and expanding scope without becoming a bottleneck.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Technical & Shipping Capabilities:</strong> Proven track record of taking technical launches or integrations from ambiguity to production across teams and partners. Hands-on ability to write TypeScript, Python, or Rust, read API docs, inspect endpoints, and debug using terminal tools (logs, cURL).</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Model Ecosystem Expertise:</strong> Deep familiarity with new models, labs, and inference providers. Hands-on understanding of streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, rate limits, token pricing, and provider-specific model behavior variations.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Product & SRE Mindset:</strong> Data-driven product instincts to advocate for adding, modifying, or retiring catalog items. SRE approach to defining, measuring, and alerting on service health, managing incidents calmly, and fixing root causes.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Agent Workflows & Detail-Oriented Execution:</strong> Daily experience building with agents—scoping work, verifying outputs, and integrating deterministic checks or human judgment appropriately. Meticulous attention to detail regarding model IDs, context limits, per-token prices, and response fields.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Qualifications (Nice to Have):</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="16,5,1,0,0">Experience at an inference provider, model lab, model router, eval platform, or API company.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,5,1,1,0">Background in evals, ranking/recommendation systems, observability, metering, or usage-based billing.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,5,1,2,0">Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers, AI Gateway, Workers AI, or Replicate.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,5,1,3,0">Relevant domain backgrounds in engineering management, SRE, partner engineering, evals/applied ML, technical program management, or solutions engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $230,000 - $317,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $275,000 - $303,000</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health car

title: (Senior) SEO & GEO Manager // AI Music Video Platform
description: Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Organic search has historically been our most important acquisition channel: product pages, free tools and landing pages in many languages that bring musicians and creators to us every day. It has never had a dedicated owner. At the same time, search is changing faster than at any point in the last decade, and more and more discovery happens inside AI answers on Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity. We're looking for our first Senior SEO & GEO Manager to own organic acquisition end to end: decide what we build and why, make it genuinely useful, get it shipped, and show what it changed in signups and paying customers. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership. You'll work directly with the founder, with our engineers on implementation, and with our content and creator team. We're looking for people with high agency and a bias to action. Tasks Own our organic search strategy and a prioritized roadmap: which pages, tools and fixes, in what order, and the business reason behind each Diagnose and prioritize technical SEO on a modern Next.js site - crawling, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, canonicals, structured data, hreflang and speed - and ship - where possible - updates to it yourself with AI Research search intent and turn it into acquisition pages and free tools that genuinely help musicians, labels and creators, and that bring them into the product Write, edit and improve English landing pages and briefs yourself, and keep quality high across our localized pages Expand our approach to AI search: define the prompts that matter, measure where we appear and which sources AI answers rely on, run documented experiments, and get Neural Frames into the places those answers come from Earn relevant authority through partnerships, PR, communities and honest comparisons Report from discovery to qualified signup and first payment, separate brand from non-brand, and be clear about what attribution can and cannot show Run one shared SEO and GEO backlog with engineering and content, and follow every item through to launch and measurement Requirements You have personally owned organic acquisition and can show what your work changed in qualified traffic, signups, paying customers or revenue - including the baseline, the timeframe and your own contribution You have strong technical SEO fundamentals, including JavaScript-rendered sites, and you turn audits into realistic, prioritized implementation plans You’re a heavy creator of AI workflows, but retain the human touch You write excellent English and have sharp judgment about search intent. You can write a landing page that ranks and converts, not just brief one You have run concrete AI-search experiments and can explain how you measured them, what failed, and what you're still unsure about You're comfortable in Search Console, an SEO research tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush, and product analytics such as PostHog You work independently: you find opportunities, prioritize them and get them done without waiting for someone to prepare the tasks You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week Bonus points: Organic growth experience with an international self-serve subscription, creative tool or consumer SaaS product Product-led free tools, useful programmatic SEO, or multilingual sites You make music or video yourself, or know AI creation workflows well Benefits VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus. neural frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all. title: Senior Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d) – Conversational & Agentic AI
description: Dein Impact Du gestaltest für eine Zukunft, in der Menschen seltener Apps öffnen und der Agent sie dort erreicht, wo sie gerade sind: im Chat, per Messenger, Mail, Sprache oder Benachrichtigung. Gestaltet wird das Erlebnis über alle Kanäle, nicht über einzelne Screens. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen eine agentische KI erleben, die sie durch ihr Arbeitsleben begleitet und dabei unterstützt, souverän über ihre Karriere zu entscheiden. Dazu gehört, dass sich ein System, das in ihrem Auftrag handelt, nachvollziehbar, vertrauenswürdig und leicht bedienbar anfühlt. Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen, nicht nur, wie es aussieht. Neue Fähigkeiten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Product von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Konzept. Du verantwortest den Bereich Design & UX und legst das Fundament für ein wachsendes Produkt: Prinzipien, Design System, Informationsarchitektur und eine Arbeitsweise, die mitwächst. So arbeiten wir Wir bauen agentische KI nicht nur als Produkt, wir arbeiten auch selbst damit. In unserem agentengestützten Entwicklungsprozess wird aus Konzepten in kurzer Zeit lauffähiger Code, mit automatisierten Reviews und Tests in jeder Phase. Für dich heißt das: Zwischen deinem Entwurf und dem fertigen Feature liegen Tage, nicht Monate. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und KI-Agenten zusammen, testest Ideen am echten Produkt statt am Klickdummy und entwickelst die Art, wie Design und Engineering bei uns zusammenarbeiten, aktiv weiter. Deine Aufgaben Produkt & Konzeption: Du übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse und Geschäftsziele in Produktkonzepte. Du entwickelst User Journeys, Story Maps und Feature-Konzepte und bringst sie mit Product, AI-Team und Engineering zur Entscheidungsreife. Discovery & Research: Du planst und führst Nutzerinterviews, Usability-Tests und Konzeptvalidierungen durch. Du machst aus den Ergebnissen klare Empfehlungen für die Roadmap. Kanalübergreifendes Erlebnis & Conversational Design: Du entwirfst, wie PAIDAI über Chat, Messenger, E-Mail, Sprache und Benachrichtigungen hinweg ein und dasselbe Gegenüber bleibt. Du entscheidest, welcher Kanal zu welchem Moment passt und wann der Agent von sich aus aktiv wird. In der App lässt du Chat, Formulare und strukturierte Ansichten zusammenspielen und übersetzt KI-Verhalten so, dass sichtbar wird, warum etwas vorgeschlagen wird, und nicht nur, was . Mensch & KI im Zusammenspiel: Du gestaltest die Momente, in denen die KI an menschliche Expert:innen übergibt, so, dass für Nutzer:innen ein durchgängiges Erlebnis entsteht. Design System & Informationsarchitektur: Du baust unser Design System in Figma auf und pflegst es, im Einklang mit der PAIDAI-Marke. Es reicht über grafische Oberflächen hinaus: Du legst fest, wie PAIDAI in Sprache und Text klingt, wie sich der Agent verhält und wie sich Nutzer:innen durch das Produkt bewegen. Design im agentischen Workflow: Du sorgst dafür, dass Designentscheidungen sauber in unseren Entwicklungsprozess einfließen, etwa über klare Specs, Komponenten und Regeln, an denen sich Entwickler:innen und Agenten orientieren. Du reviewst, was gebaut wird. Vertrauen & Compliance by Design: Du gestaltest Einwilligungs-, Datenfreigabe- und Transparenzmomente so, dass sie DSGVO und AI Act erfüllen, ohne Nutzer:innen auszubremsen. Dein Profil Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als UX/UI- oder Product Designer:in, davon einen relevanten Teil mit Verantwortung für Konzepte oder einen ganzen Produktbereich Ein Portfolio, das deinen Weg vom Problem über das Konzept bis zum ausgelieferten Produkt zeigt, inklusive der Entscheidungen, die du unterwegs getroffen hast Erfahrung in der Konzeptarbeit an der Schnittstelle zu Produktmanagement, z. B. mit Story Mapping, Priorisierung oder Hypothesen-Validierung Du denkst über einzelne Screens hinaus und gestaltest Abläufe über mehrere Kanäle und Zeitpunkte hinweg Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, Design Systems und komponentenbasiertem Arbeiten Neugier auf KI-getriebene Produkte und darauf, selbst mit KI-Agenten zu arbeiten Erfahrung mit Conversational, Voice oder Multichannel Design ist ein Plus Du arbeitest eigenständig, vertrittst deine Konzepte überzeugend und arbeitest gern eng mit Engineering zusammen Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1) Was wir bieten Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du baust ein Produkt, das Menschen im Arbeitsleben stärkt, vom Vertragscheck bis zur nächsten Karriereentscheidung. Was du gestaltest, macht für echte Menschen einen Unterschied. Innovation: Agentische KI im Produkt und im eigenen Entwicklungsprozess. Bei uns arbeitest du mit Methoden, die anderswo noch Zukunftsmusik sind. Federführend gestalten: Du prägst Produkt und Design eines jungen KI-Startups von Anfang an und baust den Bereich Design & UX selbst auf. Eigenverantwortung: Du triffst wegweisende Entscheidungen, eigenständig und im Team. Flexibilität: Hybrid, drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro mitten in Hamburg Teamgeist: Ein interdisziplinäres, motiviertes Team Weiterlernen: Regelmäßiges Mentoring und fachliche Unterstützung Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als jedes Häkchen auf einer Liste. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Hintergründe und Lebenswege. Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich direkt hier über „Jetzt bewerben“ mit Lebenslauf und Portfolio. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant IT (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Formation Search ist eine IT-Personalvermittlung aus Berlin. Wir vermitteln IT-Freelancer für Projekte und besetzen Festanstellungen einschließlich Führungspositionen. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Business Systems mit SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 und Power Platform sowie Data & AI und Cloud. Unsere Kunden sind IT-Beratungen, Microsoft- und SAP-Partner und Unternehmen im DACH-Raum. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest deinen Technologiebereich und steuerst ihn mit eigenem Umsatzziel. Du gewinnst Neukunden auf Entscheiderebene und baust Rahmenverträge und Key Accounts aus. Du triffst Kunden und Kandidaten regelmäßig persönlich, vor Ort beim Kunden, bei uns im Büro und auf den Fachmessen der Branche. Du setzt dein Netzwerk aus Kunden und Kandidaten ein und erweiterst es gezielt. Du besetzt Freelance-Projekte und Festanstellungen selbst und gibst dein Wissen an jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der IT-Personalvermittlung und nachweisbar hohe Umsätze Ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Kunden und Kandidaten im IT-Umfeld Deine Stärke ist Business Development, und du hast schon nachweislich eigene Kundenportfolios aufgebaut. Du suchst das persönliche Gespräch und bist gern beim Kunden vor Ort. Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch Was wir bieten Ein sehr gutes Fixgehalt Eine überragende Bonusstruktur, bei der sich dein Umsatz direkt in deiner Vergütung zeigt Firmenwagen Hervorragendes Training auf jedem Level, vom Einstieg bis zur Teamführung Persönliche Termine bei Kunden und auf Messen, die wir aktiv unterstützen und organisieren Ein Büro am Potsdamer Platz und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten Flexible Arbeitszeiten und kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung Interessiert? Prozesse verbessern: Du erkennst, wo es im Alltag hakt, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst uns, unseren Kundenservice kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tickets abzuarbeiten, sondern Kunden wirklich weiterzuhelfen. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt: Du hast idealerweise bereits im Kundenservice, in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf gearbeitet – gerne im Handel, E-Commerce oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld. Freude an der Beratung: Du hörst zu, erkennst Kundenwünsche und hast Spaß daran, passende Lösungen und Produkte zu empfehlen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du telefonierst gerne, schreibst verständliche E-Mails und bleibst auch bei schwierigen Gesprächen freundlich und souverän. Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen und Bestellungen den Überblick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten. Eigeninitiative: Du denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest lieber Lösungen, als Probleme weiterzureichen. Digitale Affinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit modernen Systemen und findest dich schnell in neue Programme und Abläufe ein. Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen und weißt, dass guter Kundenservice nur gemeinsam funktioniert. Vorkenntnisse in der Fenster- und Türenbranche sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du über unsere Produkte wissen musst. title: Product Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin (US), London (UK)</p> <h4><strong>Role Summary</strong></h4> <p>As a Product Security Engineer, you will support security assessments and vulnerability operations for Cloudflare’s core software products. In this role, you will analyze system architecture, threat model new features, and ensure that product-related security findings are accurately triaged, routed to the correct engineering owners, and mitigated within our SLAs.</p> <p>On any given day, you might conduct a deep-dive security review on a new feature design, triage a complex bug bounty submission, or work directly with engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities from different sources like bug bounties, SAST, fuzzing and penetration tests. You will also work autonomously to identify areas where our manual processes slow down. You will write code and integrate AI/LLM solutions to automate initial triage and data enrichment, building tools that help the team handle security findings at scale. In short, your work will sit at the intersection of Product Security, Vulnerability Operations, and internal AI Tooling. Ideally, you have experience in conducting academic/vulnerability research with a focus on systems security.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement AI Security Solutions:</strong> Identify process bottlenecks and build AI-driven tools or scripts to help automate code analysis, optimize triage, and streamline Product Security workflows.</li> <li><strong>Security Reviews & Threat Modeling:</strong> Conduct structured security reviews and threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE) across product features, defining security requirements early in the development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Product Vulnerability Management:</strong> Manage the operational lifecycle of product security findings. Ensure vulnerabilities are verified, mapped to the correct engineering owner, and tracked to mitigation in alignment with established SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Bug Bounty Triage:</strong> Perform the technical triage and validation of Cloudflare’s external Bug Bounty submissions, verifying exploitability and evaluating business risk.</li> <li><strong>Pentest Coordination:</strong> Support internal and external penetration testing engagements by reviewing findings, clarifying technical context, and assisting development teams with remediation strategies.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with DevOps and product teams, acting as a reliable security point of contact and helping developers implement secure coding practices.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Product/AppSec Expertise:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Product or Application Security within large-scale distributed cloud environments or SaaS platforms.</li> <li><strong>Practical AI & Automation Engineering:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Must possess hands-on engineering experience leveraging AI/LLMs to solve operational or technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis:</strong> Competency in threat modeling methodologies and the ability to evaluate code flaws to determine their actual engineering and security impact.</li> <li><strong>Vulnerability Lifecycle Operations:</strong> Experience tracking, routing, and driving the remediation of software vulnerabilities across engineering groups while working against defined SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaboration & Communication:</strong> Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, clearly communicating technical security risks to software engineers and resolving ownership ambiguity constructively.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Offensive Security Tooling:</strong> Familiarity with modern exploitation techniques, fuzzing frameworks, or automated scanning utilities.</li> <li><strong>Program Management Experience:</strong> Experience scaling crowdsourced security programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) or optimizing agile project management workflows within JIRA.</li> <li>Experience in integrating hardware security features into production code bases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration.
