title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description: About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Role summary How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality? We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware. What you will do Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact. Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy. Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents. Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios. A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff. Core qualifications Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program. Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations. Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output. An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results. Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team. Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization. This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive . What we offer Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods. Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed. Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone. Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals. Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do. Own it and get it done. Results matter! Make each person better together than they would be as an individual. Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
description: InMobi (Corporate) InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. InMobi Advertising InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com. Glance Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com. Overview of the Role: InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising. You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV. This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships. This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed. The Impact You'll Make: As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA. Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management The Experience We Need: Industry experience . You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them. An advertising technology expert . You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions. A trusted advisor and consultant . You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them. A high-energy, passionate self-starter . You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment. Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller . You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action. A proactive problem solver . You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration. Eager, curious, and a fast learner . You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle. Education . A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus. Language . Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who: Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks Compensation & Benefits Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. Salary Range (Germany): The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy. Note : Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. Benefits: As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process. Equal Opportunity & Inclusion InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG). InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you. Data Privacy Notice (GDPR) In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role. Your data will be retained for the duration of the recruitment process and, where applicable, for a period thereafter in accordance with statutory retention obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties outside of the recruitment process without your explicit consent. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise your rights or for any data privacy enquiries, please contact: ----- By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understood this data privacy notice and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes. — DEUTSCHE FASSUNG — InMobi Advertising ist ein weltweit führendes Technologieunternehmen, das Marketingfachleuten hilft, die entscheidenden Momente zu gewinnen. Unsere Werbeplattform erreicht über 2 Milliarden Menschen in mehr als 150 Ländern und wandelt Echtzeitkontext in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse um – auf Basis datenschutzfreundlicher Grundsätze. InMobi genießt das Vertrauen von über 30.000 Marken und führenden Publishern und vereint Intelligenz, Kreativität und Verantwortlichkeit. Durch die Kombination von Sperrbildschirmen, Apps, Fernsehgeräten und dem offenen Web mit KI und maschinellem Lernen bieten wir aufmerksamkeitsstarke Werbeplatzierungen, präzise Personalisierung und messbare Wirkung. Mit Glance AI gestalten wir die Zukunft des KI-gestützten Commerce neu und revolutionieren das E-Commerce-Erlebnis durch inspirationsgeleitete Entdeckung und Shopping. Glance AI ist darauf ausgelegt, sich nahtlos in alltägliche Verbrauchertechnologie zu integrieren und jeden Bildschirm in ein Tor für sofortige, persönliche und freudvolle Entdeckungen zu verwandeln. Glance AI bietet zutiefst personalisierte Einkaufserlebnisse in Bereichen wie Mode, Beauty, Reisen, Accessoires, Wohnen, Haustiere und mehr. You’ll act as an independent self-starter, taking ideas from 0 to 1 with minimal guidance, validating results, and deciding what's next. You’ll partner closely with our marketing team and others to design and execute cross-functional campaigns that moves CHEEX forward. title: Head of Product
description: Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time Location: Berlin, Germany (office first) Start date: As soon as possible Company: Venture-backed AI startup, early stage About the Company We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money. The Role We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you. What You’ll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers. Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on. Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality. Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business. Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team. Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals. Who You Are 5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping. A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role. A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call. Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem. Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do. A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions. Based in Berlin or ready to relocate. Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base). Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets. You’ll Thrive If You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none. You move fast and are energised by an intense, ambitious environment. You have a “no task is too small” mindset and lead by doing. You love being in the office and believe in-person collaboration drives speed. What’s In It For You Ownership from day one. You’ll define the product, with direct access to the founders and zero red tape. A role that grows with you. As the company scales, so do your scope and your team. Shared upside: top-of-market compensation and generous equity. A mission that matters. You won’t be optimising ad clicks. You’ll be helping businesses and the public sector cut waste on a huge scale. Our Process Review: All applications reviewed within 5 days. Intro call: 30 minutes on your background and motivations. Product deep dive (remote): 1 hour on your product thinking and problem-solving. On-site (half day): Work through a real product use case with the team, followed by 1:1s with Engineering and GTM. Offer: A quick final decision and transparent feedback straight after the on-site. title: Mandatory Internship – Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)
description: About ecopals ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, while continuously expanding our product and technology platform. As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for Product Development Engineer (m/f/d) . The role works closely with our R&D team on the identification, assessment and development of new products, formulations and production routes. The role combines materials science and engineering with data analysis and modern AI-assisted technical workflows, with a strong emphasis on using these tools to accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor. Tasks In this internship, you will help turn early technical ideas into structured development programmes and support the evaluation of which product and process routes are worth pursuing. Areas of responsibility Product development research. Researching potential development routes for new products, formulations and processes based on scientific literature, technical documentation, experimental results and first-principles understanding. Development-route assessment. Comparing materials, technologies, mechanisms and production concepts and identifying promising routes for further development. Technical and economic feasibility. Preparing structured assessments and reports on technical feasibility, process requirements, raw materials, costs and potential economic viability. Test programme development. Supporting the design of experimental programmes, including formulation matrices, variables, testing methods and evaluation criteria. Experimental and laboratory support. Preparing material samples for internal testing, external laboratories and customers; assisting with the preparation and execution of in-house experimental setups; and supporting the documentation and evaluation of experimental results. Laboratory coordination. Supporting the planning and coordination of testing activities with internal and external laboratories, suppliers and technical partners. Data analysis. Processing and evaluating experimental data to identify trends, correlations, performance drivers and development priorities. Technical data management. Building and maintaining structured databases for formulations, raw materials, test results, literature and development projects. Programming, data analysis and AI-assisted workflows. Using Python and modern AI-assisted development tools, including AI agents, to clean, structure, analyse and visualize technical data; automate repetitive R&D tasks; support technical research; and build internal analytical workflows. A key part of the role is learning to use these tools effectively and responsibly, with proper validation, documentation and control of the resulting work. Technical standards and regulations. Researching and analysing standards, specifications and regulatory requirements relevant to products under development and their potential applications. Technical reporting. Preparing clear technical reports and decision documents that translate scientific, experimental and economic information into actionable development recommendations. Independent development work. Taking ownership of defined development questions and following them from initial research through analysis and experimental validation. Requirements Currently completing a Master’s degree or comparable advanced university programme in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering or a related field. Good foundations in chemistry, materials science, construction materials and/or industrial processes . At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above , gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, laboratory work, industrial projects or professional experience. Strong analytical skills and confidence working with quantitative technical and experimental data. Programming and data-analysis skills , preferably with Python or comparable tools. Previous experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is valuable but not required. More important is the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt these workflows and use them rigorously — understanding what the tools are doing, checking their outputs, identifying errors and ensuring that analyses remain technically sound and reproducible. Ability to work systematically with scientific literature, experimental results and complex technical information. Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints. A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus. An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application. Your Benefits Direct involvement in product development , contributing to technologies that may become future ecopals products. Exposure to the full development process , from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment. Practical experimental experience , supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities. Hands-on experience with technical data and analytical tools , including opportunities to improve how R&D data is structured, analysed and used for decision making. Practical experience with AI-assisted R&D workflows , including programming, automation and diligent use of AI agents as technical working tools. Proximity to decision making , working closely with R&D and company leadership on which development routes to pursue. Responsibility from an early stage , with ownership of defined technical work packages and development questions. A steep learning curve across materials science, chemistry, industrial processes, data analysis and applied R&D. Practical exposure to industrial R&D , including collaboration with laboratories, suppliers and technical partners. Meaningful impact , contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions, improve circularity and increase the performance of critical infrastructure. This position is a mandatory internship . A corresponding confirmation from your academic institution, stating the requirement to complete an internship, must be provided prior to the start of the internship. Sounds like you? structurer des réponses transverses et activer les bonnes expertises (métier, data, technologique, créative) au sein de VML Consulting et du réseau WPP.</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation, couplée à une l’agence.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market de VML Consulting sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie, afin d’en faire l’acteur afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence commerciale en interne, en particulier auprès de la communauté managériale pour l’inspirer, la faire progresser et développer ses appétences et son niveau d’impact business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Conseil :</em></p> <ul> <li>Réalise, seul ou en équipe, des missions de conseil sur les title: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Your Role We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale. This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production. Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus. Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. Video Interview with Head of Data : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members : A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role. In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . description: Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir. Heute arbeiten wir vor allem mit DATEV Unternehmen Online und Tableau. Benefits Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, dazu jeweils ein halber Tag frei an Heiligabend und Silvester, und bei Bedarf zusätzlicher unbezahlter Urlaub, um die Akkus wieder aufzuladen. title: Manager of IT Asset Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Atlanta, US</li> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>Seattle, US</li> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until November 23, 2026.</strong></p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>We are seeking an experienced Manager of IT Asset Management to help build and scale our Asset Lifecycle Operations Team. This is a leadership role and part of our broader Infrastructure Operations organization which is focussed on the deployment and maintenance of IT infrastructure assets across our global deploy base. This group is responsible for building, scaling, and running one of the world's largest and most important cloud networks. Cloudflare’s global network spans more than 330+ cities, and is a key strategic asset that supports all of our customers and products. As a leader on this team, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the performance, availability, and security of our infrastructure.</p> <p>Serving as the central owner of infrastructure assets across Cloudflare's global network, the IT Asset Manager establishes foundational DCIM processes, tooling, and policies to govern the complete asset lifecycle. In this position, you will execute a clear operational vision to maintain precise asset records, satisfying key security and financial controls while driving automated, scalable service deployment.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-paced environment where you will be expected to drive both project delivery and operational excellence through continuous improvement, standardization, and optimization. This isn't just about day to day operations; it's about building a scalable, performant, secure, and resilient infrastructure that plays a critical role in aiding Cloudflare to build a better Internet.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Ensure accurate recording of capital investments, whilst maintaining the pace of execution needed by our engineering teams </li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional partners including Technical Project Managers, Capacity Planning Analysts, Engineering Managers,  Finance, and Security to meet strategic group initiatives </li> <li>Manage key third-party vendors and contractors involved in ITAD activities, holding them accountable for performance and service level agreements (SLAs)</li> <li>Drive a culture of continuous improvement by championing standardization, optimization, and automation.</li> <li>Design and enforce the global DCIM Workflow and Change Management policies (MAC process), ensuring strict ITIL/ITSM compliance across IT, Facilities, and Deployment teams worldwide</li> <li>Support the complex, bi-directional API/database integration between DCIM platform and core enterprise systems (ERP, CMDB, etc) to automate asset management lifecycle changes</li> <li>Partner with the DCIM and Capacity Planning Analysts to develop forward-looking capacity models, ensuring resource availability and optimization for new Cloudflare services</li> <li>Establish and track key operational metrics (e.g., Workflow Compliance KPIs, Data Accuracy Rate), providing executive reporting on infrastructure risk.</li> <li>Lead and mentor the members of the Asset Lifecycle Operations Team</li> <li>Foster a best-in-class operations team by bringing fresh perspectives, leadership acumen, and a focus on employee engagement.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>You are an experienced engineering leader and DCIM expert, with a passion for building high-performing teams and a track record of driving operational excellence. You will set strategy, establish priorities, and mentor a group of top technical talent. This role is for a hands-on leader who can rapidly learn, adapt, and apply learnings to enable fast and sustainable growth. title: Product Line Manager
description: About Wallee Group AG Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers. The Role The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy. In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products. The Impact You’ll Make Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes. Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization. Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives. Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis. Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals. Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing). What Success Looks Like Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed. Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk. Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains. Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs. Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches. What You Bring to the Table Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software. Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus. Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis. Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach. Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships. Languages: Fluent in English and German. Why Join Wallee? Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready. True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year. Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters. Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation , aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets , and a social calendar filled with events . The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled. Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Your responsibilities will encompass contract drafting, negotiation, process improvement and training. As an essential part of our team, you'll contribute to the foundation of our business relationships and help us navigate the complex world of contracts with precision and efficiency. Join us in shaping the way we manage contracts and elevate our commitment to excellence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, with exceptional organizational and time management abilities.</li> <li>Proficiency in contract management software or tools.</li> <li>Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment globally.</li> <li>Prior experience in ad-tech is a plus.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Location:</strong></p> <p>This position is based in London or remotely within the United Kingdom, title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description: Contexte Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes. Profil recherché Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés. Type de contrat Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Nice to have: Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks. Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM. Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed. How We Win Speed is the feature. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. Vous incarnez une posture de vente “architecte” : comprendre des enjeux clients transverses – commerciaux, opérationnels, data, technologiques, réglementaires – et y répondre en orchestrant des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :</p> <ul> <li>Responsable de bout en bout du parcours d’avant-vente et de vente de nos offres et de nos <em>capabilities </em>auprès de clients et prospects,</li> <li>Consultant ou directeur de mission, mobilisant une compréhension fine des enjeux B2B et énergie pour structurer des réponses transverses et activer les bonnes expertises (métier, data, technologique, créative) au sein de WPP Enterprise Solutions et du réseau WPP</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation, couplée à une posture “architecte”, est la clé du succès : être à la fois expert de la vente complexe, capable de lire des enjeux clients transverses, et en maîtrise des pans complets du métier du conseil et de l’agence.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie, afin d’en faire l’acteur le plus attractif, singulier et impactant,</li> <li>Construit et anime un plan de comptes ciblé (énergéticiens, utilities, grands comptes B2B) pour maintenir une intensité relationnelle élevée auprès des décideurs, défendre notre positionnement et détecter les opportunités de croissance,</li> <li>Pilote, en posture d’architecte, la construction de propositions adressant des enjeux transverses : cadre la problématique client, structure la réponse et orchestre les Business Units et expertises (data, conseil, technologie, créatif) nécessaires à sa conversion,</li> <li>Met en œuvre, en continue, l’excellence du parcours de vente via les processus et les outils internes à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale de la démarche commerciale en interne,</li> <li>Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de WPP Enterprise Solutions dans le cadre de la vente et après celle-ci,</li> <li>Assure un suivi régulier des prestations et des relations avec les clients donneur d’ordres et les opérationnels pour s’assurer de l’adéquation de la prestation avec le besoin, et identifier des opportunités de suite ou d’extension de la mission,</li> <li>Contribue au thought leadership de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les enjeux B2B et énergie (transition énergétique, décarbonation, expérience client B2B, data), via des prises de parole valorisant nos convictions et nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,</li> <li>Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie (acteurs, enjeux réglementaires, dynamiques de marché) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence commerciale en interne, en particulier auprès de la communauté managériale pour l’inspirer, la faire progresser et développer ses appétences et son niveau d’impact business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Conseil :</em></p> <ul> <li>Réalise, seul ou en équipe, des missions de conseil sur les sujets B2B et énergie, afin de maintenir un haut niveau de crédibilité et de légitimité dans la dimension Business,</li> <li>Pilote des missions de conseil, sur l’ensemble des composantes : qualité des livrables, respects des plannings et des engagements, tenue de l’équilibre budgétaire,</li> <li>Fait évoluer son savoir-faire et ses connaissances via une veille continue sur les sujets qui comptent pour nos clients et prospects, mais aussi des formations et sa curiosité,</li> <li>Maîtrise et met en œuvre toute la chaîne de production d’une mission de la prise de commande au recouvrement, pour assurer performance opérationnelle complète,</li> <li>Manage des équipes pluridisciplinaires de consultants dans le cadre des missions, et assure une coordination et une information continue de sa hiérarchie pour permettre un feedback constructif et le développement des compétences,</li> <li>Garantit la capitalisation du savoir et des livrables sur ses missions, et partage des retours d’expérience autant que de besoin.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous justifiez de 7 à 15 ans l’énergie (énergéticiens, utilities, transition énergétique).</li> <li>Notre métier consistant à vendre et réaliser des missions mobilisant une grande diversité de compétences (data, conseil, créatif, technologique), vous avez développé une véritable appétence pour la vente “architecte” : savoir lire des enjeux clients transverses et y répondre en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires.</li> <li>Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</li> <li>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité avec des décideurs – Directions Générales, Directions Commerciales et B2B, Directions Marketing, Directions de la Transition Énergétique, Directions des Opérations ou DSI – fait de vous un acteur à l’aise et performant, de la découverte du besoin à la conclusion d’un deal équilibrant les intérêts du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.</li> <li>Les enjeux des marchés B2B et du secteur de l’énergie vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en avant-vente comme en mission.</li> <li>Votre rigueur et votre ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Intégrer WPP Enterprise Solutions, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, Nous rejoindre, c’est participer à une aventure collective au service de l’épanouissement personnel.</p> <p>Nous menons à bien notre projet d’entreprise sans sacrifier nos valeurs :</p> <ul> <li>Un positionnement clair</li> <li>Le respect de chacun</li> <li>L’engagement auprès de nos clients</li> <li>L’épanouissement professionnel et l’entente entre collaborateurs</li> </ul> <p>Vous partagez ces valeurs, rejoignez-nous !</p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: Account Executive - Mid-Market - France
description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > Which team will you be joining? We are seeking a motivated and high-performing Account Executive with experience in Mid-market sales as we turbo charge our revenue engine. As a AE on the Growth team, you will own the selling of the Primer suite of products from end to end. With a consultative approach, you will lead the sales cycle with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CFOs, and VP / Director level functional leads. You will also drive the Sales strategy by owning all aspects of the sales cycle from prospecting to discovery to close. This will include cross-functional work to develop the customer strategy and contribute to other revenue initiatives. The growth team at Primer is focused on both Mid-Market and SMB accounts. We work with founders and executives across a wide variety of verticals to gain an in-depth understanding of their business. 🔍 What will you be doing? Own and manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to closing, focusing on Mid-market-level accounts in France. Build a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, and strategic partnerships. Develop tailored sales strategies to engage key decision-makers and demonstrate the value of Primer’s platform. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success, to deliver exceptional customer experiences, update cross-functional teams with feedback from prospects, continue to hone our Ideal Customer Profile and action upon unique insights derived from your knowledge of our customers. Contribute to team projects focused on developing and refining our sales process and playbooks. Staying informed on industry trends and payment innovations to provide valuable insights to clients. Provide consultative selling to identify customer challenges and present innovative solutions. Accurately forecast sales performance and maintain detailed records using CRM systems. 👀 What we’d love to see: Driven to consistently exceed goals and expectations. A go-getter, with a bias towards action and the ability to produce results in fast-paced, highly ambiguous situations. Proactive, improving existing processes and developing best practices. A strategic negotiator, with a passion for closing deals. A life-long learner Curious about prospects, their needs, and how Primer can help. Energetic and bring a positive attitude to everything you do. ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone. Our benefits 🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one 💰 Competitive share options 🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken 🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities 📅 Workations & Company Retreat 💻 The best equipment for your role 🏠 £500 towards your home office setup 🔎 Generous learning budget 🏥 Private Medical Insurance 📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits ( depending on location) Don’t meet every single requirement? At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief. title: Sr. Professional Services Consultant
description: Onwards Together! Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters. Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running. Location: Paris Our Team's Vision: The Customer Experience (CX) organisation is responsible for delivering successful customer outcomes across the entire post-sales lifecycle. Within CX, Professional Services plays a key role in translating customer goals into practical delivery: designing, deploying, and operationalising Illumio solutions in a way that builds confidence, drives value, and supports long-term customer success. Your Impact: As a Sr. Professional Services Consultant, you consistently deliver high-impact results, applying your full qualifications and experience to drive outcomes and add measurable value. You work independently on customer deployments and problem resolution while collaborating with senior team members on more complex architectural considerations. In this role, you will: Act as a trusted advisor for clients, assisting them with the integration of Illumio into their environments Manage deployments and upgrades of the Illumio platform, ensuring successful implementation by coordinating timeframes and required resources. Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance on change preparation for Illumio deployments. Assist in the development of Illumio-specific API scripts to enhance service deployment, monitoring, and management. Provide best practices, documentation, and recommendations for optimizing the use of Illumio. Prepare and maintain project documentation throughout the engagement. Monitor and troubleshoot the Illumio deployment, addressing anomalies and performance issues. Serve as the primary interface between client teams and Illumio’s product and support teams. Provide metrics and reporting on the Illumio deployment’s effectiveness. Support internal teams with integration documentation and assist with security ruleset and policy development. Facilitate testing and validation of the Illumio platform for client service teams. Conduct knowledge transfer and training sessions on the Illumio product set for client teams. Complete necessary administrative documentation, including timesheets and weekly reports. Your Toolkit: You bring both technical depth and professional maturity to the role, including: 5+ years of consulting or advisory experience. Strong experience with Linux (CentOS/Red Hat preferred) and Windows Server platforms. Experience with cloud computing service provider models (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) Experience with container platform architecture (Kubernetes, Openshift, etc.) Experience with automation and scripting tools (e.g., Bash, Python, Ruby, Chef, Puppet, Ansible). Expertise in networking concepts, including network flows, protocols, and application security controls. Problem-solving ability to diagnose and resolve issues in unfamiliar technology environments. Ability to work with evolving technology and quickly adapt to new tools. Client-facing skills, including conflict resolution and project management experience. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences. Broad understanding of IT infrastructure. Existing Experience within Professional Services team of a security vendor is a strong advantage. Willingness to travel to HQ in Silicon Valley for product training and knowledge development. Ability to quickly assimilate new product knowledge and apply it effectively in customer environments. Prior experience with Illumio is not required - training will be provided. #LI-SL1 #LI-HYBRID Our Commitment Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience. For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
