title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Evaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) - CDD de 12 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC). Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris. La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes. Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde. L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc. L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS : · Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants, · Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, … · Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ? · Comment discriminer les différentes fibres interrogées après un coupleur ? Influence des points réflecteurs, · Etude des différentes marges de puissance pour une mesure DAS, · Potentielle présence de nœuds d’insertion et limite de la transparence optique, · Sensibilité des mesures DAS en fonction des différents types de fibre et de leur environnement, · Influence du réflecteur final sur la capacité d’écoute. Le caractère innovant sera la définition des conditions du réseau et des configurations et des performances DAS permettant un audit cyber sur des infrastructures déjà déployées. Au-delà d’une synthèse des configurations que l’on peut trouver sur le terrain, il s’agira de mener des tests, soit sur un réseau réel auxquels un accès nous sera donné, soit sur un réseau modèle implémenté pour l’étude. Ces travaux permettront d’identifier le type de modules d’interfaçage nécessaires, et de les spécifier, puis de les concevoir et de les fabriquer. Vos principales missions seront : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs à fibre optique distribués Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en génie électrique, en communications optiques, en photonique, en capteurs optiques ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez d’une solide expertise théorique et pratique en photonique et en traitement du signal numérique, ainsi que de bonnes compétences en programmation. Une connaissance des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique, notamment dans le cadre de la détection cohérente, constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais, et la pratique du français est souhaitée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement multiculturel. Vous êtes à l’aise pour encadrer des stagiaires ou des étudiants dans le cadre de projets. Enfin, vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques, ainsi que d’une excellente capacité d’analyse et de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). title: Senior Systems Administrator (Linux)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Bluestaq Limited<br></strong>Bluestaq starts with our people. If you bring curiosity, ownership and a thirst for delivery, we would like to hear from you.</p> <p>Every society runs on invisible systems; Bluestaq is that, for data. title: Solutions Architect
description: <p>We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.</p> <p>MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations. </p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Germany.</p> <h3>As an ideal candidate, you will have:</h3> <ul> <li>5 to 8  years of related industry experience, ideally 2 years of experience in a customer facing role</li> <li>Minimum of 2 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity</li> <li>Experience implementing scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology</li> <li>Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership. </li> <li>Ability to work with a cross functional sales team to formulate and execute an end to end deal cycle.</li> <li>The ability to travel up to 25%</li> <li>A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience</li> <li>Fluency in German and English required</li> </ul> <h3>You may also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications with any of the major cloud providers </li> <li>Experience working in a technical pre-sales capacity </li> <li>Experience with database programming and data models </li> <li>Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects</li> <li>Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message</li> <li>A MongoDB Certification</li> <li>A Cloud Provider Certification</li> </ul> <h3>What you do at MongoDB:</h3> <p>In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:</p> <ul> <li>Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB</li> <li>Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders</li> <li>Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)</li> <li>Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events</li> <li>Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction</li> <li>Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members </li> <li>Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends</li> </ul> <h3>What you will learn:</h3> <p>MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:</p> <ul> <li>Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database</li> <li>Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts</li> <li>Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly</li> </ul> <p>Market-Relevant Technologies:</p> <ul> <li>Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms</li> <li>Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p>Modern Architecture Design:</p> <ul> <li>Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security</li> <li>Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journey and working with industry leading partners in the space</li> </ul> <p>Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:</p> <ul> <li>Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding</li> <li>Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling</li> </ul> <p>Industry Insights:</p> <ul> <li>Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. </p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. title: Senior Consulting Engineer
description: <h3>The team</h3> <p>MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem. </p> <p>Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Germany.</p> <h3>Position expectations</h3> <p>Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime</li> <li>Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services</li> <li>Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming</li> <li>Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room</li> <li>Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services</li> </ul> <p>Pre-sales and growth</p> <ul> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take</li> <li>Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement</li> <li>Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from</li> </ul> <p>Building the practice</p> <ul> <li>Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology</li> <li>Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>Candidate profile</h3> <ul> <li>Professional fluency in German is required</li> <li>Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world</li> <li>5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - deep enough to reason about data models, consistency, partitioning and failure modes, not just operate one</li> <li>Real-world CDC and streaming-pipeline experience: Kafka or Confluent Platform, connectors, Debezium or equivalent, schema evolution, exactly-once versus at-least-once trade-offs, backfill-plus-tail patterns</li> <li>Solid grounding in relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL) and in getting data out of them without breaking the business</li> <li>Competence in at least one programming language (Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Go or similar) - enough to build pipeline glue, validation harnesses and tooling, not only to configure products</li> <li>Working fluency with AI in real engineering workflows</li> <li>Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills: you can explain a partitioning strategy to a DBA at 10:00 and a migration risk profile to a Senior Leadership at 11:00, and both leave more confident than they arrived</li> <li>An entrepreneurial bias. You see the gaps and what is missing. You are comfortable operating where the process does not exist yet, and you would rather ship a rough first version and iterate than wait for the shape to be agreed</li> </ul> <p>MongoDB expertise is not a requirement. We will teach you MongoDB - that is the part we are world-class at. What we cannot teach is the scar tissue from the platforms and pipelines above. Bring that.</p> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building with LLMs beyond personal productivity: you use LLMs and coding agents as part of how you build and deliver today</li> <li>Migration or replication tooling experience: Spark or Flink-based pipelines, dual-write patterns, cloud DMS-class services, data-validation frameworks</li> <li>One or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) at architecture depth</li> <li>Experience on the vendor or consulting side of competitive platform displacements</li> <li>Practical experience with MongoDB</li> <li>Fluency in a second European language relevant to this market</li> </ul> <h3>Practicalities</h3> <p>Travel up to approximately 30% in normal circumstances, primarily within EMEA. </p> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. Your mission is to turn those insights into action. Analyze commercial performance: Understand how our products perform across customer segments, sales cycles, usage, and revenue. Understand the market: Stay close to competitors, industry developments, and emerging customer requirements. Direct involvement in enterprise sales cycles, including discovery, demos, business cases, and commercial discussions. Strong technical understanding and experience working closely with engineering teams. Familiarity with AI and LLM-based products and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value. Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of what drives customer adoption, conversion, and revenue. Analytical skills and the ability to turn customer feedback, market signals, and performance data into clear recommendations. Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus. A proactive, hands-on mindset with high ownership and the confidence to challenge assumptions. Experience using AI tools in your daily work. Procurement experience is a plus, but not required. We're looking for someone who can quickly understand a complex market and connect customer needs with real business opportunities. Why Join Lio? Work at the intersection of product and revenue: Your work will directly contribute to winning customers and growing our business. We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology. Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany. Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus. The Role As a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) Intern , you'll join our engineering team to build technology that changes how accounting and tax work gets done. This is not an internship built around shadowing, isolated exercises, or predefined support tasks. You'll take end-to-end ownership of a meaningful, clearly scoped technical problem, work alongside experienced engineers, and contribute to systems used in real operational environments. Depending on your strengths and interests, you may work on applied AI systems, product engineering, data infrastructure, internal tools, or workflow automation. You'll learn how to move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution — and where speed, technical quality, and domain constraints need to be balanced. We don't expect you to arrive knowing German tax law. We do expect you to be curious, technically strong, and excited to understand a complex domain. What You'll Work On Production Engineering. Design, build, test, and deploy software that supports real accounting and tax workflows. Applied AI. Build with LLMs, retrieval systems, document intelligence, and agentic workflows while learning where deterministic logic and human oversight are required. Product Development. Work closely with engineers, operators, and tax professionals to understand problems, prototype solutions, and iterate based on real-world feedback. Data & Integrations. Build APIs, data pipelines, and integrations across modern and legacy systems. Reliability & Evaluation. Help develop tests, evaluations, monitoring, and feedback loops that make our systems dependable in high-stakes workflows. End-to-end Ownership. Take a clearly scoped problem from exploration and system design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Your Profile You are a strong builder. You have created software beyond standard coursework — through personal projects, open-source contributions, previous internships, research, or an ambitious university project. We value exceptional technical work over a specific educational path. You have strong technical foundations. You are comfortable with data structures, algorithms, databases, APIs, and modern software-development practices. You have high agency. You make progress without perfectly defined requirements, ask sharp questions, and take responsibility for getting to a working result. You think like an engineer. You write clear, maintainable code and think about testing, reliability, security, edge cases, and failure modes — not only the happy path. You are AI-native. You use modern AI tools in your work and ideally have hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, or other applied AI technologies. You have strong product intuition. You want to understand the user and the underlying problem instead of implementing requirements mechanically. You communicate clearly in English. German is helpful, particularly for projects involving direct collaboration with our tax advisory teams, but is not required for every project. Why Limetax Real responsibility. Own a meaningful technical problem rather than completing artificial internship assignments. Real production environments. Work with operational workflows, documents, transactions, and domain knowledge from established accounting and tax firms. Close mentorship. Build alongside experienced engineers and receive direct feedback on system design, implementation, and product decisions. Fast feedback loops. See how users interact with what you build and improve it based on real-world results. Modern engineering. Work with contemporary infrastructure, AI-assisted development tools, and an AI-native engineering culture. Early-stage impact. Help shape the systems and engineering practices that will define how Limetax scales. Path to a full-time role. We see the internship as a potential starting point for joining Limetax after graduation. Competitive compensation. Receive a competitive internship salary, with relocation support considered where appropriate. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Executive, DACH
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure , meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement. Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn. What you will do Build and develop your own client portfolio by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities within your assigned market. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster long-term partnerships. Proactively qualify new leads through daily outbound calls, follow-ups, and consistent pipeline management. Engaging in conversations with potential and existing clients, and guiding them through the sales process. Work closely with the technology team to provide feedback on platform functionality and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with both buyers and suppliers to address any issues, inquiries, or challenges that may arise during the trading process. Monitor your performance against monthly targets and KPIs, taking ownership of revenue growth within your portfolio. Stay informed about market trends, product demand, and industry dynamics to make informed trading decisions. Who you are You have prior experience in Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, or Account Management Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You demonstrate excellent German skills and strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. A basic understanding of national and international trade and supply chain management is a plus. We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength. Compensation: €70K – €75K • Yearly On Target Earnings (Fixed+ Bonus) €70K – €75K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. Ready to awaken your best with us? About The Role This is an exciting opportunity to join Emma and our E-commerce team. As a E-commerce Category Manager for Austria, you will own the Sales performance of your market from end to end. You’ll define the strategy, drive growth, and shape the customer experience. You will be a key player in our E-Commerce Europe team, contributing to cross-country and cross-functional initiatives, with regular exposure to senior leadership. You'll report to Austria's Country Manager and work closely with teams across Emma, ranging from Global Marketing, Business Excellence, Category Management to Operations and our other Ecommerce country teams. What You'll Do: Own the P&L of all 3 Product Categories in Austria with a focus on profitable growth and margin expansion. Define and execute the category strategy for our categories (Mattresses, Beds, and Accessories)—adapting the global assortment to the Austrian market and uncovering new segment opportunities. Drive Pricing Excellence: Own the local pricing strategy across channels and products to maximize revenue and margin. Lead Go-To-Market Initiatives for new product launches in Austria, collaborating with Global Product Success, Sourcing, Marketing, and UX teams. Manage the Full Product Lifecycle: Plan and coordinate phase-ins/phase-outs for a timely and cost-effective portfolio evolution. Run Campaign & Commercial Planning in alignment with your Marketing counterpart, ensuring an impactful promotional calendar. Partner with the Regional Webshop Team to improve digital conversion and category presentation. Collaborate with Operations and Sourcing to improve cost structure and supply performance for the Austrian market. Who We're Looking For: Fluency in English and German required. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Finance or Engineering. 4+ years of experience in Category Management, Business Strategy, or Consulting — ideally in e-commerce, retail, or consumer goods. Proven P&L ownership or significant contribution to commercial performance. Strategic, analytical mindset with strong commercial acumen — you understand pricing, margin drivers, and portfolio management. Business ownership mentality: you take full responsibility, act decisively, and identify growth opportunities proactively. Cross-functional executor: you align teams, manage dependencies, and follow through with high standards. Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-scaling environment. What We Offer: The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change. Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo. A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events. A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities. 25 vacation days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year). A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter, and offices in Gutleutviertel - Frankfurt. Become an Emmie We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. Work closely with business and engineering colleagues to clarify requirements, agree acceptance criteria and deliver usable solutions in small increments. Strong C# and .NET skills, plus JavaScript or TypeScript for Dynamics 365 customisation . Practical experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, plug-ins, Dataverse data modelling and security roles. Experience developing and operating applications on Azure, with an understanding of cloud security, configuration, logging, monitoring and application performance. Practical experience with REST, GraphQL and OAuth 2.0, and the ability to design, implement and troubleshoot integrations across system boundaries. Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven integration, including producers and consumers, consumer groups, delivery semantics and idempotent processing. Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD, particularly application lifecycle management for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, and deploying Azure applications. Sound judgement about software architecture, data consistency and maintainability. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate across engineering and business functions. title: Commercial & Retention Manager

Maintain a clear, prioritised pipeline of upcoming renewals and retention risks using data-driven insights and CRM automation. Excellent organisational skills to manage high-volume portfolios using data, prioritisation, and rigorous CRM discipline (we use Salesforce and Planhat). title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
description: At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​ As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​ Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production What is your Day to Day Mission: Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​. Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​. Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​. Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​. Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​. Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​. Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​. Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​. Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​. Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​. Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements. What you bring to the team: Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​. Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​. Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​. Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​. Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​. Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​. Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​. A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​. Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​. Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. title: Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
description: As a Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d), you will be an important part of our software team. You will design, optimize, and expand our test automation system to fully automate the release process and software quality of the ground station and our drone software. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones. You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development) to extend and improve the software testing pipeline. By ensuring high code quality and streamlined deployment pipelines, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). What is your Day to Day Mission: Develop a test strategy to validate our entire software stack for vertical take-off and landing aircraft (VTOL). Create new end-to-end integration tests. Review, challenge, and optimize existing test cases. Proactively expand test coverage in a structured way to identify and push system limits. Develop an automated test framework that enables developers to continuously extend the test suite. Evaluate and develop AI-powered testing solutions, including AI agent-based systems, to automate test implementation, improve test generation, and increase the efficiency of our verification processes. title: Tender Manager
description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Building the Tender Desk In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon. A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined. Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management. A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself. Ideally, you bring: A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities. Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment; Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority; The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective; Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage; Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling; Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working; Who are you? You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you. You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid. You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough. At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Aanvragen, inregelen en beheren van glasvezelverbindingen, in afstemming met leveranciers. Inrichten en beheren van datacenterkoppelingen en peering, in afstemming met datacenters en partners. Oplossen van storingen tot op de bodem, inclusief een structurele oplossing. Meedenken over de architectuur van het netwerk nu Maxitel doorgroeit. Documenteren van configuraties en netwerkschema's. Oppakken van andere technische vraagstukken die op je pad komen, samen met collega's van support en sales. Vereisten Wie zoeken wij? Social Media Management: Develop and maintain a content calendar, manage our LinkedIn presence, and identify opportunities to increase our reach and engagement. Website & Communication: Contribute to improving our website and ensure our messaging is clear, consistent, and aligned with our brand identity. title: Merchant Growth Specialist
description: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers. As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. You dive into each merchant's online performance, find the biggest opportunities and help them capture them. What you learn flows straight back into our product and playbooks. Your team You are part of the Growth team and work closely with the Growth Lead and our product team. You work hand in hand with Merchant Success, who own the day-to-day relationship with our merchants. title: Triage audicien - Beek, Limburg
description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je. Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months. Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once. Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines. At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets. Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance. Nice to have, not essential Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite. Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail. A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply. Benefits A monthly internship allowance Hybrid, with agreed office days Lunch with the team A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. Knowing what a good afternoon feels like is part of the job Sounds like your kind of work? Please apply with your CV and a cover letter, both in English. title: Production Planner
description: At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities. Taken The opportunity Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment In this role, you will be responsible for Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives. Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability. Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc. Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment. Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times. Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions. Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities. Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis. Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership. Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles). Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively. Vereisten You’ll bring: Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required). Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required). Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required). Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred. Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports. Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles. Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach. Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules. Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Benefits What Harvey provides: Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn an in-house fitness center 26 vacation days several fun company outings and parties each year Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Taken Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant. Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht. Vereisten 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor. Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe. Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier. 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. Benefits Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring. De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond. Extra bonussen bij grote wins. Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer. 25 vakantiedagen Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk. Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend. Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis. Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel. Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan. title: Senior Business Analyst
description: ABOUT THE BRAND At Karl Lagerfeld, we are driven by Karl’s mantra: “Embrace the present and invent the future.” Always contemporary and forward-looking, the House of KARL LAGERFELD shares the creative vision and design aesthetic of its iconic founder, Karl Lagerfeld. We are the only fashion house that carries Karl’s name on its door and we strive to live up to this responsibility in everything we do, every day, with the utmost joy and passion. Our headquarters in Paris and in Amsterdam are home to a highly diverse and driven team of KARL family members that hail from over 35 countries. Together, we aim to create meaningful stories and product concepts that connect to Karl’s world and iconic attributes. Women’s & Men's ready-to-wear, bags, small leather goods, swimwear and underwear are managed directly from our Amsterdam headquarters, while other categories, including footwear, fragrances, eyewear and more, are developed with best-in-class licensing partners. We connect with our consumers on multiple levels, ensuring that our online and offline approach goes hand in hand. We thrive to maximize consumer engagement via more than 200 KL stores worldwide, our premium wholesale partners, and our strong digital footprint, spearheaded by our karllagerfeld.com and 35 countries. Our digital channels currently represent more than 30% of our overall full-price business. We are a dynamic, fast-growing and inclusive company built on professionalism and strong values. At KARL LAGERFELD we’re committed to working toward the highest standards of sustainability and integrity across all areas of our business,. In 2019, KARL LAGERFELD joined as a founding member of the Fashion Pact, a global sustainability initiative seeking to transform the fashion industry through objectives in three areas: climate, biodiversity and ocean protection. THE ROLE The Senior Business Analyst is a commercially focused business partner who plays a key role in driving business performance through data-led insights, strategic analysis and actionable recommendations. Working across functions, markets and channels, the role identifies opportunities to accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability and support informed commercial decision-making. This is a hands-on position that combines strong analysis with commercial understanding. This role requires strong commercial judgement, curiosity and the confidence to challenge assumptions, influence stakeholders and proactively identify opportunities that drive measurable business impact KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Performance analysis & commercial insight Proactively identify and quantify commercial growth opportunities, working with relevant stakeholders to translate insights into measurable business actions. Analyze business performance across sales, profitability, operations, products, channels, markets, and customers. Identify key drivers, trends, risks and opportunities impacting business results. Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management Support forecasting, budgeting, latest estimates and long-range planning and provide commercially relevant insights and recommendations. Monitor performance against financial budgets, forecasts and prior year results, identifying gaps, risks and opportunities, and recommend actions where required. Develop scenario analyses and business cases to support strategic and operational decisions. Provide forward-looking visibility on potential performance outcomes and business risks. Support financial and operational planning through data-driven insights. Reporting, Data & Business Intelligence Deliver accurate, timely and relevant reporting for management and cross-functional stakeholders. Develop and maintain dashboards in Qliksense. Improve and automate reporting processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Establish and maintain data quality standards, governance and control processes. Ensure consistency in KPI definitions, reporting methodologies and performance measurement. Drive continuous improvement of reporting and analytical capabilities. Business Partnering & Decision Support Act as a trusted business partner to Commercial, Finance, Product, Supply Chain, Operations and senior leadership teams. Build strong relationships across functions and ensure alignment on performance priorities. Translate complex information into clear and compelling insights and actionable priorities for senior stakeholders. Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner. Support cross functional strategic initiatives and business transformation projects through analytical expertise and commercial judgement. THE PROFILE 7+ years of experience in business analytics, commercial analytics or a similar data-driven role Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights Advanced Excel skills (including complex formulas, pivot tables) Experience with BI tools (e.g. Qlik Sense) is a plus Solid understanding of commercial performance metrics, including sales, margin, inventory and profitability Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently Proactive, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, data-driven environment Fluent in English (written and verbal) Why #TEAMKARL? (HQ) · Learning and development courses/training · Opportunity to make an impact · Remote working arrangements · Relocation allowance · Bonus holidays · Working in the heart of Amsterdam · Brand discounts · And exclusive sample sales only for #TEAMKARL JOIN #TEAMKARL The collective vision of KARL LAGERFELD is to be the most connected global designer brand, inspiring consumers through luxury collections and immersing them in the World of KARL. If you are interested in joining #TEAMKARL, we invite you to submit your application today. At #TEAMKARL, everyone can give their opinion, grow in their career, and be part of a genuinely caring and inclusive team. title: AI/ML Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Switzerland. Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people. Accountabilities: In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements. Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows. Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices. Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects. Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs. Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems. At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement. At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept. Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement. Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation. Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline. Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship. Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation. An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress. Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions. A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience. Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences. A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits. Bonus qualifications: Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia. Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology. Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change. Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies. Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks. Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure. Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results.
