Technical ownership: Take projects from initial problem definition and model selection through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit
description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Amsterdam/Rotterdam, Noord en Oost Nederland Omschrijving van het team Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers. Taken Wat ga je doen? Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: Waarom deze rol bestaat De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen. Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn. Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft. AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat. Taken Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei. Wij bouwen Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope. Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van. De klant bouwt, wij borgen Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten. Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort. Je hebt je eigen klantportfolio en bent hun aanspreekpunt binnen SevenLab. Je begeleidt discovery sessies en workshops om tot richting en prioriteiten te komen, en je schat in wat je zelf doet, wat je samen oppakt en wanneer een specialist moet aanhaken. Vereisten Must have meerdere jaren ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties of softwareproducten; je hebt zelf software naar productie gebracht die nu live draait en door klanten wordt gebruikt, en je kunt het laten zien; je kunt in een week in je eentje iets werkends neerzetten op echte data, en je weet wat je bewust buiten scope houdt om dat te halen; je hebt eerder in een rol gezeten waarin techniek en klantcontact samenkwamen, en je kunt een klantgesprek leiden en de vraag achter de vraag vinden; je bent kritisch op codekwaliteit, structuur, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid, ook bij code die een AI-tool oplevert. Niets gaat langs jou zonder dat je het hebt getest en beoordeeld; je kunt iets veilig live zetten en live houden: deployment, monitoring, security, en weten wat je doet als het misgaat; je denkt in systemen. Kom je iets voor de derde keer tegen, dan los je het niet voor de derde keer op. Dan bouw je iets zodat het niet meer gebeurt; je zoekt het eerst zelf uit in de documentatie, de code en de logs. Blijft er een vraag over, dan stel je hem met een hypothese erbij zodat de ander in één keer kan antwoorden; je zet vaagheid om in richting, structuur en resultaat; je communiceert scherp: je legt technische keuzes uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond, en je geeft feedback op andermans werk zodat ze er wat mee kunnen; professioneel Nederlands en Engels, gesproken en geschreven. Nice to have ervaring met release-governance als specialisme: approvals, signing, rollback; ervaring in gereguleerde sectoren zoals zorg of de publieke sector; open source bijdragen op je naam. Voor wie dit is je wil eigenaar zijn van het hele traject, van eerste gesprek tot wat er live staat, en je vindt het prettig dat het jouw naam is die eraan hangt; snel en goed zijn bij jou geen tegenpolen. Je haalt dat door scope scherp te houden en te weten waar je niet op moet inkorten; je wil voorop lopen, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en wil beter worden dan je gisteren was; je denkt verder dan "kunnen we dit bouwen". Je vraagt je ook af wat het oplevert en wat de slimste route is; als er iets stukgaat, ben jij degene die het meldt voordat iemand het vraagt. Voor wie dit niet is de developer die het liefst de hele dag in zijn editor zit en klantcontact vermijdt; de consultant die adviseert wat een klant moet bouwen en daarna weg is. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk tot en met productie; iemand die veel prototypes maakt die daarna blijven liggen; iemand die de output van een chatbot doorstuurt zonder hem zelf te lezen. AI gebruiken doen we allemaal, de hele dag. title: Adviseur Financiële Effecten
description: Wil jij je analytische vaardigheden inzetten voor beter overheidsbeleid en tegelijkertijd snel groeien in een dynamische adviesomgeving? Bij Sira Consulting werk je aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken die ertoe doen. In ons kleine, hechte team combineer je onderzoek, analyse en advies om beleid en regelgeving daadwerkelijk te verbeteren. Jouw rol bij Sira Consulting Als adviseur help je ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten bij het verbeteren van beleid en regelgeving. Vanaf de start ben je betrokken bij het volledige onderzoeksproces: van de eerste analyse tot het opleveren van een concreet en bruikbaar advies. Je werkt als projectmedewerker in een projectteam en krijgt, afhankelijk van je ontwikkeling, al snel meer verantwoordelijkheid, bijvoorbeeld in het coördineren van (deel)projecten. Je schakelt veel met collega’s, opdrachtgevers en externe stakeholders en leert zo het vak van adviseur in de praktijk. title: HR consultant
description: Heb jij HR-ervaring en wil je graag jouw kennis en expertise inzetten, maar óók jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Zoek je afwisseling en uitdaging in jouw werkzaamheden? De consultants van Buro Payroll ondersteunen klanten uit diverse branches tijdelijk op het gebied van HR en/of salarisadministratie. Als HR-consultant van Buro Payroll ga je aan de slag bij onze klanten en ondersteun je de HR-afdeling tijdelijk bij uiteenlopende opdrachten. Van het verwerken van mutaties, opstellen van contracten en het meedenken aan procesoptimalisaties in AFAS tot aan het adviseren over HR-specifieke vraagstukken en deelnemen aan HR-projecten. Taken In deze rol ben jij hét HR-gezicht voor één of meerdere klanten. Je voert niet alleen de dagelijkse HR-werkzaamheden uit, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar bestaande processen. Waar kan het slimmer, efficiënter of consistenter? Jij ziet verbeteringen, signaleert deze en vertaalt dit naar concreet HR-advies waar de opdrachtgever direct mee verder kan. Onze klanten zijn divers: van gevestigde namen tot kleinere organisaties met grote ambities. Dat betekent dat geen opdracht hetzelfde is: elke werkomgeving, iedere casus en elk HR-vraagstuk biedt jou weer nieuwe inzichten. Zo blijft je werk dynamisch én ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel. Veel van onze klanten werken met AFAS. Heb je daar nog geen ervaring mee? Geen probleem! Wij zorgen dat jij precies de kennis krijgt die nodig is om vol vertrouwen aan de slag te gaan. Vanuit ons label Peopletrack zijn wij namelijk AFAS-partner, waardoor wij beschikken over voldoende opleidingsmateriaal om deze software eigen te maken! En verder… Onze accountmanagers zoeken opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw kwaliteiten, interesses én groeipad. Bij elke klant werk je samen met het lokale HR-team, zodat je nooit alleen staat in je opdracht. Daarnaast heb je een hechte groep HR-collega’s bij Buro Payroll achter je staan: sparren, vragen stellen, samen oplossen; we helpen elkaar vooruit. Minimaal één keer per maand komen we samen op kantoor voor gezelligheid, een gezamenlijke lunch en kennisdeling. Zo blijf je verbonden, geïnspireerd en onderdeel van het team. Kortom: een rol waarin je je expertise kunt inzetten, je vaardigheden blijft ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd impact maakt bij allerlei verschillende organisaties. Klaar om jouw HR-stempel achter te laten? Vereisten Wat neem je mee? Minimaal 2-7 jaar relevante werkervaring op een HR-afdeling (afhankelijk van junior, medior of senior consultant rol) MBO+ of HBO diploma bij voorkeur HRM Pro-activiteit en aanpassingsvermogen Je kunt structuur aanbrengen in je werk en prioriteiten stellen Je bent communicatief sterk; je kan goed luisteren en doorvragen Je vindt het niet erg om in het diepe gegooid te worden, aangezien je goed zelfstandig kan zwemmen. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Platform  (f/m/d)
description: Staff Backend Engineer – Platform Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. Some of the challenges waiting for you Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. Where you'll work from This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. title: Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)
description: Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech! At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. What You'll Be Up To Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. What You'll Bring to the Team At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Extra Awesome Points For Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. What We Offer A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. How You'll Make an Impact Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji: Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung . Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows. Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen. Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen. Verständnis der Zusammenhänge zwischen CRM-Systemen, Datenquellen und technischen Abläufen sowie Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft. Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft sowie sichere Anwendung von Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Plattformen als Core User. Hands-on-Umsetzung von Maßnahmen – von der Konzeption und dem Flow-Aufbau bis zur Auswertung und Optimierung. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration. Starke analytische Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Daten-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Kohortenanalysen oder vergleichbaren Experimenten. Erfahrung mit komplexen Segmenten und automatisierten Journeys in einem datengetriebenen CRM- oder Lifecycle-Umfeld. Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM- beziehungsweise Marketing-Automation-Plattform. Technisches Grundverständnis für die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe von CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und relevanten Datenquellen. Strategische und operative Arbeitsweise: Du identifizierst Hebel, setzt Prioritäten und setzt Maßnahmen selbstständig um. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer II
description: <div> <div class="attachment-overlay preview"> <div id="viewer-container"> <div id="canvas-container"> <div id="viewer" class="pdfViewer"> <div class="page" data-page-number="1" data-loaded="true"> <div class="textLayer"> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>About Tripadvisor</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p><strong>Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering</strong> is the team that builds and supports the <strong>world's leading marketplace for travel experiences</strong>. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a<strong> product-focused Software Engineer II</strong> to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging <strong>Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools</strong>. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally. </p> <p> </p> <p>We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a <strong>remote-first working model</strong> with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in<strong> </strong><strong>Oxford.</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Impact:</strong> Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.</li> <li><strong>Shape the Product:</strong> Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate & Mentor: </strong>Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.</li> <li><strong>Innovate with AI: </strong>Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Champion Operational Health: </strong>Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.</li> <li><strong>Build for Quality: </strong>Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills & Experience </strong></p> <p>We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Full-Stack Mindset: </strong>Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solving: </strong>A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven: </strong>A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.</li> <li><strong>AI Coding:</strong> you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code. </li> <li><strong>Global Mindset: </strong>Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our<strong> coding interview exercises</strong> in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive compensation packages</strong>, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.</li> <li><strong>“Work your way”</strong> with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. </li> <li><strong>Flexible schedule</strong>. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li><strong>Donation matching</strong>. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li><strong>Tuition assistance</strong>. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li><strong>Lifestyle benefit</strong>. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li><strong>Travel perks</strong>. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it. PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record. Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry. Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in. Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.</p> <p>You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Structure complex problems:</strong> break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Generate insights:</strong> conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Shape recommendations:</strong> translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Develop client materials:</strong> produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engage with clients:</strong> work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Contribute to project direction:</strong> help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build trusted relationships:</strong> work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.</p> <p>Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.</p> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <h4>Strategy and analytical capability</h4> <p>We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Experience and background</h4> <p>You will typically bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.</p> <h4>Sector interest and understanding</h4> <p>You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Location</h3> <p>London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click <a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior RF Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability. This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director RF Engineering</p> <ul> <li>Own RF front-end architecture from VHF through SHF: link budgets, frequency planning, spurious and intermodulation analysis, sensitivity and dynamic-range trade-offs.</li> <li>Design and characterize mixers, high-power amplifiers, filters, and switching networks against demanding linearity, efficiency, and thermal targets.</li> <li>Drive board-level simulation (EM, circuit, and co-simulation) and take designs through multi-layer RF PCB layout, stack-up definition, and fabrication release.</li> <li>Lead bring-up, characterization, and design-for-test; close the loop between simulated and measured performance.</li> <li>Set and enforce RF design standards, review checklists, and documentation practice across the group.</li> <li>Mentor RF HW engineers and antenna designers; raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.</li> <li>Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.</li> <li>Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.</li> <li>Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.</li> <li>Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.</li> <li>Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.</li> <li>Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.</li> <li>Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; comfortable debugging from first principles.</li> <li>Proven technical leadership of a design group — setting direction and standards, mentoring, running rigorous design reviews.</li> <li>Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Antenna design and integration — element and array design, platform effects, radiation-pattern measurement.</li> <li>Direction-finding techniques (amplitude/phase comparison, interferometry, TDOA, AoA estimation).</li> <li>Beamforming across approaches: analog, digital, and hybrid; phased arrays and adaptive/null-steering methods.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with SDR platforms.</li> <li>Experience developing and qualifying products for regulated markets — CE, FCC, and/or MIL-STD.</li> <li>Working knowledge of DSP concepts sufficient to trade functionality between analog and digital domains.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. title: Software Engineer, Backend
description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Restaurants run on a stack of tools that rarely talk to each other: one for delivery, another for online orders, another for reservations, another for loyalty, and a till that knows nothing about any of them. The same guest can look like three different customers across three different systems.</p> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's platform for fixing that. It connects marketplace ordering, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, guest management, marketing and point of sale around one shared view of the guest, so every product gets smarter as the others are used. DoorDash launched DashOS publicly at Dash Forward in September 2026, and from 2027 more than 80,000 restaurants on leading POS and middleware partners.</p> <p>DashOS Engineering brings together engineers from across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt into one global organisation, led from London. Our teams cover reservations and guest CRM, digital ordering and omnichannel loyalty, POS and self-order kiosks, AI-powered marketing and Voice AI, and the shared data and integration platforms that connect them. Each team owns its own roadmap. The shared mission is making them work as one system.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a backend-focused Software Engineer to build the high-performance, highly available services that restaurants depend on every day, from booking a table on a Friday night to recognising a regular the moment they order. You'll work closely with other engineers, product managers and designers, and because DashOS is newly launched, you'll help shape how its products connect rather than inheriting decisions someone else already made.</p> <h2><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, deploy and improve backend services for customer-facing features used by restaurants and their guests in markets around the world.</li> <li>Own features end to end, from technical design through to launch and ongoing support, including taking part in an on-call rotation to keep systems reliable.</li> <li>Work on hard problems in data, latency and scale: unifying guest identity across channels, real-time availability search across thousands of venues, and integrations with the systems restaurants already run.</li> <li>Build on DoorDash's global platform, so the features you ship can reach restaurants across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt markets rather than being rebuilt for each one.</li> <li>Work in a modern engineering environment with frequent daily releases, feature flags and AI coding agents used across code review, deployment and debugging.</li> <li>Partner with engineers, product managers and designers across London and other DashOS locations to decide what to build and how.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're excited about you because...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>You've built and operated backend services or web applications in production, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design.</li> <li>You're fluent in at least one modern backend language (we mostly use Python), and you're happy to pick up new languages and tools as the platform evolves.</li> <li>You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership of technical solutions from first design to production.</li> <li>You use AI coding tools as part of how you work, or you're keen to, and you're comfortable reviewing and taking responsibility for what they produce.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve problems that don't have an obvious answer yet.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tech you'll work with</strong></h2> <p>Our services are built mainly in Python, with performance-critical systems in Rust, running on Google Cloud and DoorDash's global platform. AI coding agents are part of how we design, review and ship code, so we care more about how you solve problems than about which languages you've used before. You won't need to know every part of the stack on day one.</p> <h2><strong>Where and how we work</strong></h2> <p>This role is based in our London office at The River Building, on a hybrid pattern of 3 days a week in the office.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. title: Composite Development Engineer
description: We are looking for a Composite Development Engineer to build the material foundation of our rocket structures and generate material data that design and analysis can trust. You will work across material selection, process development, specimen preparation, laboratory testing, and component validation. Your work will ensure that material properties are measured on the materials we use, made with the processes we intend to employ, and suitable for real engineering decisions. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Define material requirements based on system, component, manufacturing, and structural interfaces. Select composite material systems and qualify suitable manufacturing processes. Plan and run coupon-level characterisation campaigns, from specimen preparation and testing through to usable design values. Develop and characterise new material systems and processing methods. Validate material properties on manufactured components and feed results back into design and analysis. Help develop the materials laboratory, including procedures, safety practices, equipment capability, and material-handling standards. What we are looking for A Master’s degree or PhD in materials science, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline. Two to five years of experience working with composite materials; strong student-team experience will also be considered. Genuine enjoyment of practical laboratory work, including specimen preparation, testing, and fixture troubleshooting. Experience handling resins and chemicals safely, with the ability to develop procedures where they do not yet exist. A methodical approach to experimental work, measurement, documentation, and data quality. Fluent English and the ability to communicate technical results clearly. Desirable experience Carbon-fibre materials, resin systems, prepregs, laminates, or other aerospace composites. Composite test standards, including ASTM, ISO, or equivalent methods. Laboratory equipment such as DSC, DMA, tensile-test systems, microscopy, or similar materials-characterisation equipment. Working proficiency in German. Benefits and important information: We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas. Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday Free access to shared company housing Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. title: AI Project Manager

As part of our dynamic team, you will be the link between our clients, our engineers and the AI technologies we build with. Mindset: Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line. Attractive Benefits: above market pension benefits and a private accident insurance. Professional Growth: Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, offering access to valuable resources, events and support. Interested in leading AI projects that make a real difference? title: Trading Data Software Engineer
description: <p>At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition.</p> <p>IMC’s Amsterdam-based Global VMM Data team works on a centralised global data platform to serve high-quality curated data for Valuation Market Making (VMM) research and strategies all throughout IMC. We address the ever changing data requirements and our team tries to solve this in a young project building a central system to ingest, curate and expose data to our research tooling within IMC.</p> <p><strong>Your Core Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>As a Trading Data Software Engineer, you'll work on enabling high-quality research using fundamental option pricing data. Next to that you will increase researchers' focus by centralising the curation of the data and enable quick onboarding of new data sets, to allow for researching new types of strategies that are going to play a vital role in the strategies of IMC now and in the future. We build the tooling that allows a team of data curators to perform their magic and on top of that we expose our data to research tooling to provide a global access.</p> <p>You’ll write reliable, high-performance software while balancing time to production with quality and testability. Advanced automated testing and daily deployments will allow you to achieve agile and incremental benefits. Within the complex landscape of IMC and its systems and technologies, you’ll be constantly challenged to consider trade-offs between latency, throughput, simplicity, scalability and maintainability. Your core tasks will include:</p> <ul> <li>Coding, developing, testing, deploying and maintaining applications and automations for data curators, other VMM developers and Traders/researchers to support them and understand their actual needs and the data we serve them.</li> <li>Working on a young project and being involved of the architectural design of our system.</li> <li>Building a system that is highly-performant at serving petabytes of data globally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least > 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer </li> <li>Strong programming skills in Java (11+), but experience in the latest versions of Java is highly desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and Linux</li> <li>Strong programming skills with Python, especially around data - highly preferred</li> <li>Experience working in data analysis and building out data platforms and data - highly preferred</li> <li>The ability able to work under minimal supervision and to take full ownership of the applications you build</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills; ability to solve problems creatively and proactively</li> <li>Prior knowledge of trading / capital markets is not required. Curiosity and a willingness to learn is.</li> </ul> <p>Our tech stack includes an ever-evolving range of systems and technologies, and our engineers have the freedom to choose the best solution for the problem at hand. If a new technology has the potential to add value, we’ll actively invest in exploring, adopting and developing it. </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><em>IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Android Engineer
description: The Challenge More than 75% of Talk360's users are on Android. Every release you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people across more than 190 countries - migrants calling home, travellers managing emergencies, families staying connected across borders. For these users, a dropped call or a crash isn't a UX inconvenience. It's a broken connection to someone who matters. The craft challenge here is real. Our users are often on older devices, limited data plans, and unreliable networks. Building an app that performs beautifully under those conditions requires engineering excellence, not shortcuts. We're entering a new phase of growth. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and mobile remains one of the most important products in the company. We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join our mobile team. You’ll be a core contributor to app millions rely on , building features end-to-end, raising the bar on quality and performance, and working directly with Product and the business to understand our customers. title: Senior Software Engineer, R2 Gateway
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage with zero egress fees that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Gateway team owns the request-facing layer of R2 — the S3-compatible API gateway that every object put, get, list, and delete flows through. When a customer or application talks to R2, they talk to the systems we build and operate.</p> <p>R2 is growing rapidly, and the gateway must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for the API surface that handles authentication, request routing, rate limiting, and coordination between clients and R2's storage and metadata layers — all while maintaining strict compatibility with the S3 API and delivering low-latency, highly available access at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, storage infrastructure, and edge computing — building request-path systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable on every single call.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and operate the S3-compatible API gateway that serves every R2 operation, ensuring correctness, low latency, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high-throughput request traffic with strong availability and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the request path end to end — authentication, authorization, routing, rate limiting, and error handling — and the interfaces between the gateway and R2's storage and metadata layers.</li> <li>Own projects end to end: from design docs through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Continuously improve the reliability, performance, and observability of the gateway; ramp quickly into unfamiliar and legacy code paths and reduce operational toil.</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that raise reliability standards.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, metadata, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate API contracts, capacity planning, and cross-cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in Rust, TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>5+ years of experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems on the request path, with strong latency and reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, HTTP/API gateways, edge computing, or service-oriented architectures.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating high-throughput APIs — authentication, routing, rate limiting, and backward-compatible API evolution.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with the S3 API surface, or with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms, is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Time Off</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Key Responsibilities: Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product. Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records. Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness. Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability. Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance. Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required. Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance. Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated. Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures. Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core

title: Productowner

title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead , who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team. What you'll be doing Core Responsibilities Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB. Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering. Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on. Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location. Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip. Supporting Responsibilities Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix. Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing. Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace , applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready. Your Profile MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology. 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count. Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems. Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together. Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems. Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did. Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift. A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right. Good command of technical English. Bonus if you also bring: Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly. Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting. Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment. Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines.
