title: Engineering Manager, Data Center Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and avai

You will be responsible for driving security research, exercises, and activities that emulate real world attackers and attacks to drive improvements in Cloudflare’s security posture focusing on AI, Agents, harnesses and LLM’s. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Security and Vulnerability Research: </strong>Stay current with emerging threats and perform deep-dive research to identify AI-specific vulnerabilities and risks in addition to general vulnerabilities across Cloudflare’s products and services.</li> <li><strong>Agentic testing and adoption: </strong>As a core function, identifying AI-related attack surfaces through rigorous testing of agentic implementations and LLM usage which will help  define requirements and implementation guidance while proactively. </li> <li><strong>Adversary Simulation:</strong> Execution of full-chain red team operations targeting Cloudflare’s global infrastructure, corporate networks, and product ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>Efficacy Testing:</strong> Establish a rigorous framework for testing "Security Efficacy"—measuring exactly how well our WAF, EDR, and SIEM detections perform against known TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures).</li> <li><strong>Purple Teaming:</strong> Foster a highly collaborative relationship with the Blue Team (Detection & Response) to ensure findings are translated into immediate defensive improvements.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship & Growth:</strong> Be a technical leader, providing technical expertise while fostering a culture of curiosity, ethical hacking and partnering to improve Cloudflare’s security posture. </li> <li><strong>Executive Reporting:</strong> Translate complex technical exploits into risk-based narratives for leadership, helping prioritize engineering resources where they matter most.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Security Incident Response Team (SIRT):</strong> You will act as the "sparring partner" for SIRT. executives and to turn complex financial or technical concepts into simple narratives.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional attention to detail</strong>, and pride in getting every number right.</li> skill</strong>: fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong>, including awareness of materiality, fair disclosure, and Reg FD (or a strong willingness to learn).</li> <li><strong>Genuine interest</strong> in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or AI, and in the public markets.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area calms frustrated customers.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,2,0">Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Strategy Manager to join the Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation team, focused on Technical Programs. This person will help Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Developer GTM leadership identify the right customer opportunities, organize technical GTM work, and turn high-value customer engagement into repeatable programs and operating rhythms.</p> <p>The Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation function exists to evolve the way the Developer GTM team works, designing systems, processes, and GTM motions that accelerate consumption at Cloudflare. This role is focused on the technical side of that motion: where we should spend time, how we coordinate technical resources, how we run customer-facing programs, and how we measure whether technical work is driving the right business outcomes.</p> <p>The right person is a high-agency operator with strong technical fluency. They do not need to be a Solutions Architect, but they should be comfortable working with technical products, customer architectures, implementation workflows, developer platforms, and customer-facing technical teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build and scale technical programs: </strong>Design proactive programs for Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and related technical GTM teams. Turn ad hoc motions into repeatable playbooks, operating rhythms, and ownership models where it makes sense.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate strategic customer engagement:</strong> Project manage high-priority customer initiatives that require technical GTM support. Clarify goals, stakeholders, timelines, resourcing, risks, success criteria, and follow-up.</li> <li><strong>Plan and scale technical onsite visits:</strong> Build the planning model for strategic customer onsites, including intake, agenda design, staffing, prep, execution, post-onsite follow-up, and measurement.</li> <li><strong>Improve prioritization and visibility:</strong> Own a clear view of active technical engagements, upcoming opportunities, blockers, outcomes, and resourcing needs. Partner with Revenue Engineering, Data, Sales Strategy, and technical leaders on account propensity, engagement tracking, dashboards, and operating reviews.</li> <li><strong>Support Professional Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and feedback loops for technical services offerings.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and launch new technical programs:</strong> Lead high-priority projects across Developer GTM, support team planning and process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of projects this person may own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a proactive SA/FDE engagement program for a priority customer segment or product motion.</li> <li>Partner on an account propensity model that helps determine SA/FDE prioritization, resourcing, and account coverage.</li> <li>Stand up a technical engagement tracker for active customer work, resourcing, blockers, and outcomes.</li> <li>Design the planning and follow-up model for technical onsite visits with strategic customers.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to package a repeatable services motion and build the business case for rollout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solutions Architects and FDEs have a clearer operating model for proactive programs and strategic customer engagements.</li> <li>Leadership has a reliable view of technical revenue pipeline, engagement health, account propensity, and investment ROI.</li> <li>Strategic customer initiatives and technical onsite visits move faster because goals, staffing, owners, success criteria, and follow-up are clear.</li> <li>Professional Services offerings are easier to understand, price, package, and align to Cloudflare's broader consumption-led strategy.</li> <li>New technical GTM motions move from ambiguous ideas to measurable programs with durable owners.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, technical program management, solutions strategy, consulting, or a similar cross-functional execution role.</li> <li>Experience working with technical customer-facing teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Developer Relations, or Product.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency, including the ability to understand customer architecture discussions, implementation tradeoffs, developer platform concepts, and the operating needs of technical GTM teams.</li> <li>Strong program management ability, including managing complex work streams, driving accountability without direct authority, and keeping teams aligned under pressure.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership; someone who takes initiative, works independently, and manages time effectively.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Highly customer-centric, with natural curiosity about technical products and a strategic mindset for solving complex problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working under pressure and adjusting priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including comfort using spreadsheets, CRM data, and business dashboards to prioritize work and inform decisions.</li> <li>Prior experience with Salesforce CRM, Tableau, BigQuery, or BoostUp is a plus.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) is a strong plus.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $161,000 - $221,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $153,000 - $210,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.</li> <li>Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. This role demands a unique combination of high-level strategic vision, a passion for experimentation, creativity, and a relentless commitment to world-class physical execution.</p> <p>First and foremost, you are a builder of impactful, high-performance spaces. You will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design and construction of workspaces that serve as the tangible, physical manifestation of the local Cloudflare culture.</p> <p>At the same time, you are stepping into uncharted territory. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Your creativity, physical hospitality, and human judgment will guide every project, ensuring our global spaces continuously evolve alongside our teams.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Physical Execution & Cultural Identity:</strong> Lead the physical realization of Cloudflare’s global offices. Direct architects, general contractors, and artists to design and build spaces that authentically capture the vibe and culture of each local hub, ensuring every environment feels uniquely Cloudflare, inspiring, and functional.</li> <li><strong>Conceptualize and execute the AI Workflow:</strong> Think outside the box to architect how AI and automation can revolutionize legacy design and construction phases. Map out and execute opportunities to eliminate manual bottlenecks across the entire project lifecycle - including vendor onboarding/benchmarking, contracting, cost estimation, budget/project tracking, and risk identification - by implementing automated review pipelines and data-driven quality controls.</li> <li><strong>Drive Spatial Experimentation:</strong> Treat our workplaces as living laboratories. Conceptualize and implement pioneering internal qualitative and quantitative data-collection methods - such as tracking real-time utilization patterns and capturing continuous employee feedback loops - to architect data-driven proposals that evolve our global footprints based on your findings.</li> <li><strong>Evolve the Design Framework:</strong> Use data insights and post-occupancy metrics to constantly challenge existing design assumptions. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Team</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We build the tooling and platform capabilities that power the next generation of AI agents on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. Our goal is to make it easier for agents to interact with the web, and to be observed and controlled while they do it — without giving up performance, scalability or security.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the centre of that work, and it is the product this role owns. It runs full browser sessions on Cloudflare’s global network and lets developers drive them with code or with an agent: a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint that any Puppeteer, Playwright or CDP client can connect to from anywhere, Workers bindings, and a REST API for the common jobs — screenshots, PDFs, Markdown extraction, scraping and crawling. On top of that sit session recording and replay, live debugging, and a path for a human to step in when an agent gets stuck.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">It is used by external developers building agents, crawlers and scrapers, and by other Cloudflare teams who need a browser they can trust. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. Browser Run is the focus of this role today; there is scope for more of that portfolio to come into it as the role and the team grow.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run went from an internal rendering tool to a public, billed product, and the surface has not stopped moving — the CDP endpoint, MCP client support, session replay and the REST API all landed inside a year. That pace is the point, and it is the thing this role has to make sustainable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a tight-knit team that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on engineering management role. You will own Browser Run engineering end to end — the people, the roadmap, the reliability, and the story we tell customers about it. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. You will be expected to understand it well enough to review a design document, challenge an architecture, and know when an estimate is wrong.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What you’ll do</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Manage, coach and grow the team of systems engineers behind Browser Run — 1:1s, career development, performance conversations, and hiring.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the Browser Run roadmap and delivery, and give the team and the wider organisation clear visibility into what is being worked on, in what order, and what we are deliberately not doing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with Product Management to set direction: shape the roadmap, pressure-test scope, and make the trade-off calls that keep an incubation product shipping.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own Browser Run’s operational health — browser fleet capacity, session reliability, cold-start latency, concurrency limits, on-call rotations, alert quality and incident follow-through. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. with the broader developer platform (Workers, R2, D1, Agents SDK).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,2,0">Identify and evaluate customer and partner segments where Cloudflare's inference model evaluating Cloudflare for GPU capacity and inference workloads.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,1,0">Lead strategic sales conversations, helping prospects understand the architectural and economic advantages of our approach.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,2,0">Collaborate with Sales and Developer GTM leadership to build repeatable qualification frameworks and deal structures for inference revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,0,0">Serve as Cloudflare's primary listener and synthesizer for inference market signals: pricing shifts, competitive moves, model ecosystem changes, and emerging workload patterns.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,1,0">Facilitate internal alignment across Product, Strategy, Engineering, and GTM leadership to translate market intelligence into clear product and commercial decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,2,0">Partner with the AI Gateway / Models Marketplace team to align strategy across both the hosting and consumption sides of the model ecosystem—ensuring our GTM motion is coherent across all channels.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Analytics & Business Rigor</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,0,0">Build the analytical foundations for the inference business: unit economics models, customer segmentation frameworks, win/loss analysis, and pipeline forecasting.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,1,0">Define and track meaningful business metrics for an inference platform at our stage—focusing on sustainable growth, product-market fit, and revenue quality.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,2,0">Utilize data-informed insights to guide strategy, test hypotheses, and adapt approach as market dynamics evolve.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">GTM & Domain Experience:</strong> Demonstrated leadership in GTM strategy, revenue growth, or strategic sales within AI infrastructure, cloud compute, or developer platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p economics, GPU capacity dynamics, and ecosystem players.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Analytical Aptitude:</strong> Ability to build financial models, analyze complex datasets, and translate quantitative insights into actionable strategy.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Strategic Communication:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting insights to executive leadership, technical decision-makers, and prospective partners.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Adaptability:</strong> Comfort navigating fast-evolving markets, making informed decisions with imperfect data, and adjusting strategies as dynamics shift.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="19,0,0">Experience at an AI infrastructure company (inference provider, model marketplace, GPU cloud) or background as a technical co-founder.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="19,1,0">Familiarity with Cloudflare's developer platform, network architecture, and edge ecosystem.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="19,2,0">A background combining financial/quantitative analysis with hands-on GTM execution.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="19,3,0">Direct experience building collaborative frameworks across product and go-to-market teams.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For SF based hires: Estimated annual salary of $221,000 - $304,000</li> <li>For NY based hires: Estimated annual salary of $211,000 - $290,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> This team in particular is focused on Cloudflare’s infrastructure budget, strategy, investment plan,  and costs. </p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for an early-career Infrastructure Business Operations Associate to work directly with Cloudflare's Infrastructure Strategy organization. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>As an IT Operations Specialist I, you will provide essential onsite IT support and help maintain daily workplace technology at our corporate office. Working in a heavy macOS and Google Workspace environment with additional support for Windows and Linux endpoints, you will deliver hands-on technical assistance, maintain office AV systems, and manage end-to-end hire-to-retire lifecycle processes. In this role, you will also leverage our internal AI technology tools to optimize support workflows and documentation. You will collaborate closely with broader IT teams, the IT Service Desk, HR, Places & Office, and Security teams to ensure a seamless technical experience for all employees.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary onsite technical support resource, managing employee walk-ups, support tickets, and hardware troubleshooting across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.</li> <li>Work closely with broader IT engineering and operations teams to execute infrastructure updates, enforce system policies, and resolve escalated technical issues.</li> <li>Manage complete hire-to-retire IT operations, including hardware provisioning, account setup, leading IT orientation for new hires, offboarding asset recovery, and access revoking.</li> <li>Administer day-to-day user accounts, permissions, and group access within Google Workspace and connected corporate SaaS tools.</li> <li>Manage physical IT asset lifecycle operations, including inventory tracking, hardware check-in/check-out, stock audits, and secure device disposal.</li> <li>Utilize internal AI technology tools to summarize support incidents, speed up ticket resolution, and draft self-service Knowledge Base (KB) documentation for end users.</li> <li>Support office conference room technology (Google Meet Hardware and Zoom Rooms) and provide live technical setup for corporate town halls and department events.</li> <li>Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation (evenings and weekends) to address critical after-hours P1/P2 incidents, system outages, and urgent executive support needs.</li> </ul> <p>This is an in-office/onsite position. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.</li> <li>Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).</li> <li>Willingness and availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.</li> <li>Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.</li> <li>Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with macOS endpoint management using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms like Jamf Pro or Kandji.</li> <li>Experience using corporate ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.</li> <li>Relevant technical certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA A+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Our mission is to ensure our global infrastructure scales seamlessly, reliably, and efficiently by optimizing rack integration, supplier ecosystems, and lifecycle operations.</p> <p>About the Role</p> <p>As Manager of Hardware Integration Operations, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for supply coordination, rack engineering readiness, third-party integration, and deployment coordination. title: Performance Engineer, Kernel and Memory
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> <li>European Cloudflare Hubs</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.</p> <p>The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.</p> <p>We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.</li> <li>Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community.</li> <li>Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards.</li> <li>Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements.</li> <li>Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together.</li> <li>A track record of upstream Linux contribution, ideally including maintainership or sustained work in MM or an adjacent subsystem.</li> <li>Strong systems programming in C, with the judgement to make high-risk changes to shared infrastructure safely.</li> <li>Ability to dive deep into a complex codebase while keeping the fleet-wide picture in mind, and to own a problem and its outcome rather than a single patch.</li> <li>Clear communication with engineers across many teams, since the symptoms of an MM problem usually show up far from the MM code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonuses</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals pertaining to memory management</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment
